> _TLDR: Democrats just won big. This is part one of a series I 'll be doing on what Democrats should do with their power. In this post, I'll argue why we need to pick someone different from Hakeem Jeffries or Chuck Schumer for leadership. If you are already on board, sign A Fight Worth Having's petition telling Democrats in the House and Senate to change Democratic Party leadership below:_
[Block Schumer and Jeffries](https://substack.com/redirect/90a4bd22-2d58-4d93-8bd6-6330daafca22?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
On Tuesday, Democrats won. And they didn't just win. This is the biggest Democratic wave since 1974, when Nixon resigned over Watergate. It's looking like Democrats will end up with about a 90-seat majority in the House and, though the count is still coming in, they seem likely to have 56 seats in the Senate. And more exciting than them winning is what these candidates promised to win. In South Carolina, Annie Andrews flipped South Carolina by saying healthcare is a right, not a privilege, and[ calling for banning private equity from owning hospitals](https://substack.com/redirect/891a5b5c-d51b-4b7f-bd40-ad9f84137ba7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Scott Colom flipped Mississippi by[ rejecting AIPAC and denouncing corporate donations](https://substack.com/redirect/cd7b3da6-0673-4ea0-8e1a-ff16cf60834e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). James Talarico flipped Texas by[ campaigning against the billionaire class trying to buy our elections and rig the system in their favor](https://substack.com/redirect/6be48cfa-bfe3-42f2-a02b-e4231e7df0fa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Abdul El-Sayed won Michigan by[ vowing to end the war in Iran and our funding of genocide in Gaza](https://substack.com/redirect/fdc131d6-c28e-4719-aaa9-8e7bee970e58?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), so we can instead invest that money in housing, healthcare and education at home.
The Democrats who won the hardest states and districts did so by running against a rigged economic and political system. They ran to protect the little guy from the big guys. And they ran on change. And change doesn't just mean taking on Trump - it means changing the Democratic Party as well.
But Chuck Schumer and Hakeem Jeffries will never allow the system to be changed. Schumer will never[ allow the filibuster to be abolished](https://substack.com/redirect/a657cb00-6a94-42e1-9e55-a9bdba603f15?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), even though[ Talarico is calling for it.](https://substack.com/redirect/82d8ef9c-47a0-440e-b713-55307e9f6c2e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Neither Schumer nor Jeffries will[ ever allow America to stop funding Israel's genocide](https://substack.com/redirect/3ee90cee-112d-4c7c-a812-b2eacc886a35?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), despite the fact that even[ JD Vance is saying America's relationship to Israel](https://substack.com/redirect/60fb6ebf-aaea-493a-9f38-3957a6500b4a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) was one of the top four reasons Republicans just lost in a bloodbath. Neither Schumer nor Jeffries will ever let us pass Medicare-for-all or a raise to the minimum wage or raise taxes on corporations and billionaires, even though all those policies poll at nearly 70% support with the American people. Schumer and Jeffries can't support them because their number one priority is keeping Democratic Party donors happy, and the donors don't want it.
And the American people know this. Polling by Center for Strategic Politics and Redbox Research found that a majority of Harris voters in 64% of districts surveyed want someone other than Hakeem Jeffries for Speaker of the House:
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/255dd0dd-acb2-4b8b-8f88-7910f6810c1a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
And according to polling from Data for Progress, a majority of Democrats want someone other than Schumer for Senate Majority Leader:
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/bdbb2f1e-d57d-47f3-9eba-5019a63f4601?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
So herein lies the problem. Democrats just won with a huge mandate to end the war in Iran, lower the cost of living, and take on corporate power in America. But Democratic leadership is against all of that. It's why Jeffries continuously blocked the War Powers resolution last year when it had a chance of stopping the war in Iran. It's why Democrats in the Senate never filibuster the NDAA to block defense spending, even though they could. So if we keep the same Democratic Party leadership, we will fail on delivering what Americans just told Democrats they want - and we will lose this majority.
The people who just got elected from those swing states understand that. That's why so many of them, like Abdul El-Sayed from Michigan, Troy Jackson from Maine, and Adam Hamilton from Kansas, have already committed to not backing Schumer for leader.
The problem, though, is that it's risky for elected members to say they won't back Schumer or Jeffries for leader. If they do it and lose that gambit, they risk retribution from leadership in the form of being kept off committees, having no money get sent back to their districts, or even having a primary challenger be put up against them by the establishment.
So that's where you come in. The leadership fight is happening right now. Who becomes the next Speaker of the House and Senate Majority Leader will get determined in the next few weeks. Hakeem [has already started making the calls to get folks on his side,](https://substack.com/redirect/0be71b93-3ca1-4be9-907d-5a3eecdd175d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and I'm sure Schumer is doing the same, so time is of the essence if we want to see change.
We already have the polls showing Americans want a change in leadership, but polling only goes so far. The main way elected officials know their constituents actually care about an issue is when they see them actively engage on it. One way to do that is to call your representative - in the House and the Senate - to tell them that you would like them to not vote for Jeffries or Schumer for leader. Another would be to sign the petitions below:
[Block Schumer and Jeffries](https://substack.com/redirect/90a4bd22-2d58-4d93-8bd6-6330daafca22?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[A Fight Worth Having](https://substack.com/redirect/f4e3a860-bf04-4132-bc96-f236a1dbd9ae?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) is running these petitions, and their plan is to deliver the petition to every relevant Congressmember. Signing these petitions shows that making sure Jeffries and Schumer aren't leaders isn't just popular, but that it's also _salient_.
It's good to have some wins. Now let's give voters the change they voted for.
_Join me on the journey as we explore both the politics and the policies to turn this country around so it works for everyone and not just a handful of people at the top._

---
Dear Patriot,This letter couldn't wait.That's why Kirk Cameron personally asked me to write you on the post-production budget shortfall for "Iggy and Mr. Kirk." He wanted to make sure you heard about this urgent situation as soon as possible.**And after you hear what's going on, I hope you'll support BRAVE FOR GOOD.** **[We are facing a serious budget shortfall of $48,523.](https://click.freedomwirealerts.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fsecure.anedot.com%2Fbrave-for-good%2Ftrig594-34jmj68%3Futm_source=REV%26utm_medium=EMAIL%26utm_campaign=20261105_BDG_BFGO_REV_EMAIL_IINJ-TRIG/1/010101a1ae40996b-7fa20560-0c50-4a67-ad02-49cf7c77b4cf-000000/9RhZIzokuHsYRrlDkJ9XMZk9vLuA0P3Xwlp0gF11JO8=452)** But before I go into more detail, let me tell you a little about our mission to help parents instill wholesome and Godly values in America's children. Kirk just wrapped up this year's "See You at the Library Day," where we countered the Left and brought conservative values straight to America's children.Kirk is busy spearheading the "Bible Revival" movement that gets Biblical values -- that America was founded upon -- back into schools. And Kirk just finished filming Season 3 of our television show "Iggy and Mr. Kirk" that teaches children how to respond to the deceitful culture with Biblical values and steadfast faith.**I'm writing you with such urgency because Season 3 of "Iggy and Mr. Kirk" is in jeopardy.** **[And if I can't raise $48,523 in the next four weeks, "Iggy and Mr. Kirk" will be delayed -- or even postponed indefinitely.](https://click.freedomwirealerts.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fsecure.anedot.com%2Fbrave-for-good%2Ftrig594-34jmj68%3Futm_source=REV%26utm_medium=EMAIL%26utm_campaign=20261105_BDG_BFGO_REV_EMAIL_IINJ-TRIG/2/010101a1ae40996b-7fa20560-0c50-4a67-ad02-49cf7c77b4cf-000000/TK_GdId9d4GieefLE0TgDCLij4UhdQsPacSt6bMFMNM=452)** The radical Leftists who attack us because we're reaching America's children with God's Truth would love nothing more than to see "Iggy and Mr. Kirk" shut down.They hate that "Iggy and Mr. Kirk" has skyrocketed to the top of Angel Studios' streaming service. They hate that we've created a path around the addictive mind rot they put on TV.It's like Kirk always says... It's not enough to complain about culture raising our children. We must create something better for them. The first 2 seasons of "Iggy and Mr. Kirk" have reached millions of children and counting, but Season 3 is in jeopardy.If "Iggy and Mr. Kirk" isn't funded, there will be no voice on TV countering the Left's dangerous lies.Lies like Drag Queens leading a Pride Parade SingAlong on Blue's Clues...Same-sex weddings on Arthur... And Sesame Street using YOUR tax dollars to normalize same-sex parents and men in dresses.And that's just what's on TV. Not to mention the thousands of 'Queer Kid' videos on platforms like YouTube Kids.The days of The Andy Griffith Show and Father Knows Best are gone. The Left has purposely used TV to create a generation of zombie children who are glued to their screens."Iggy and Mr. Kirk" is the antidote to that Leftist TV brainwashing.It uses low-stimulation production and teaches children how to respond to the deceitful culture with Biblical values and steadfast faith. Like when Mr. Kirk teaches Iggy:
---
* to love how God created him as an iguana, even when the villainous Culture the Vulture says Iggy must become a human to fit in.
* to rely on the wisdom of parents -- one mom and one dad -- to solve life's problems.
* to be BRAVE by speaking truth in the face of the Left's lies.

---
| | | **[BRAVE FOR GOOD needs to raise $48,523 in the next 4 weeks just for "Iggy and Mr. Kirk."](https://click.freedomwirealerts.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fsecure.anedot.com%2Fbrave-for-good%2Ftrig594-34jmj68%3Futm_source=REV%26utm_medium=EMAIL%26utm_campaign=20261105_BDG_BFGO_REV_EMAIL_IINJ-TRIG/3/010101a1ae40996b-7fa20560-0c50-4a67-ad02-49cf7c77b4cf-000000/R8krLFyMsnIEx3EoPPCQBSolCaPAn1FWGm_mvmVgMEU=452)** That doesn't even begin to account for our "Bible Revival" efforts and the conservative Story Hours for the rest of the year. Fellow Patriot, please help. Because this is so urgent, I wanted to reach out to Americans who share our concern for the next generation.On behalf of myself, Kirk, and our entire team, thank you for considering supporting BRAVE FOR GOOD. Together, we will rebuild a culture that honors God and His will for our lives.
---
Sincerely, Dr. Trent TalbotFounder, BRAVE for Good
---
**P.S.** I told Kirk Cameron I would write you with this URGENT update while he's swamped with "See You at the Library Day," our "Bible Revival" movement, and Season 3 of "Iggy and Mr. Kirk." **I hope you can help with your tax-deductible gift of $50, $100, or even $500.** Thank you for caring about America's families!

subject: Now, we must deliver. Yes, even with Donald Trump in the White House. Read my op-ed:

body:
Warren for Senate: https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/370?source=em-header&t=1001&akid=3078%2E4032634%2ELqr5bd

First and foremost, to all the voters, volunteers, campaign
staff, candidates, and small-dollar donors who made this week’s victories
possible: Thank you, thank you, thank you.

Because of you, Democrats were elected statewide where a lot of people
thought we couldn’t win. Texas, South Carolina, Kansas, Iowa!

We took back our majorities—not by a squeaky little margin, but with a
bold mandate.

This marks the beginning of the end of the Trump era.

And now, the real work begins.

I wrote down my thoughts in TIME to line out why Democrats did so well,
and exactly how we can use our majorities to make real changes and bring
down costs.

Yes, we can do this even with Donald Trump in the White House. Yes, we can
do this even if Republicans don’t want to cooperate. Yes, now — not in two
years.

And we absolutely must. You can read it below, or [ https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/4879?t=1006&akid=3078%2E4032634%2ELqr5bd ]visit the link here
to share with the people you care about.

Thanks for being a part of this,

Elizabeth

--------------------------------------------------------------------------

Senator Elizabeth Warren: Why Democrats Won the Midterms

Democrats won their largest congressional victory since the 1976 Watergate
election—overwhelmingly flipping both the House and Senate. And while the
dance music is still playing, a debate has already burst forward over
whether those election results were merely a rebuke of President Donald
Trump’s failures, and whether it was progressives or moderates who
produced the secret recipe for Democrats’ success.

These are the wrong questions. Anyone seeking to understand the midterm’s
lessons should start here: Democrats won by being populist economic
fighters who were unafraid to call out the corrupt politicians and
corporate interests who have rigged the system at the expense of everyone
else.

Now, Democrats must deliver. Yes, even with Donald Trump in the White
House.

In 2024, Trump swept back into power, declaring he would cut costs on “day
one” and bragging he would “end inflation and make America affordable
again.” Instead, Trump and Republicans took a wrecking ball to the
economy, cutting health care to finance tax breaks for rich people and
giant corporations, imposing chaotic tariffs, and launching a war with
Iran. With astonishing brazenness, Trump has attempted to reengineer the
federal government into a corruption machine designed to rake in profits
for himself, his family, and his cronies.

In the most competitive 2026 races, in blue, purple, and red states,
including places like Texas and South Carolina that have not elected
Democrats statewide for decades, Democrats won by recognizing Americans’
economic pain, denouncing Washington corruption that has made a rigged
economy worse by favoring giant corporations over working people, and by
pledging to upend this system.

Democrats relentlessly and rightfully criticized Trump’s economy, but we
also made a much deeper point—and it struck home. The first Democratic
Governor of Texas in 30 years, Gina Hinojosa, said, “The one fight in this
country is about economic power.” Red-state winners like Sherrod Brown,
James Talarico, and Jon Ossoff called out a “rigged” system. In South
Carolina, Annie Andrews pledged to take on “big insurance, big tech, big
pharma, and the utility monopolies.” Josh Turek promised to fight for
Iowans, “not for billionaires and large corporations.” Chris Pappas
declared to New Hampshire voters in his victory speech: “Tonight’s results
are a wake-up call for the corporate special interests and billionaires
who have been rigging the economy.”

Just campaign rhetoric? Nope. Across the country, Democrats stood up for
big policy changes like increasing the federal minimum wage, expanding
child care, reining in Big Tech, data centers, and AI, and reforming
health care. We came with plans—specific policies to dismantle a rigged
system and beat back concentrated corporate power.

From Mary Peltola in Alaska to Roy Cooper in North Carolina, Democrats
called for blocking grocery store mergers that drive up prices. Both
Iowa’s Josh Turek and Texas’ James Talarico promised to break up vertical
integration between insurance companies, pharmacy benefit managers, and
pharmacies. Maine’s Troy Jackson and Michigan’s Abdul El-Sayed beat
Republicans by proudly campaigning for Medicare for All. And plenty more
Democrats like Lindsay James (IA), Zach Dembo (KY), Denise Powell (NE),
and Jamie Ager (NC) flipped Republican seats after demanding a public
insurance option that is available to all Americans. Not long ago, trying
to flip a seat from red to blue by promising to raise taxes on the rich
was considered unthinkable. But Democrats did just that—and won.

None of this happened without Democrats putting in the work to earn the
trust of voters. Our new housing affordability law—that Donald Trump
refused to sign—was a critical proof point. And in races from Kentucky to
Indiana to South Carolina, candidates loudly proclaimed their support for
blocking private equity from gobbling up housing. Andrews and Kansas’s
Adam Hamilton specifically campaigned on cracking down further on Wall
Street ownership of single-family homes than the historic provisions that
passed Congress this summer.

Now it’s time to act. Donald Trump says he wants to work with Democrats.
We should force him to do that on the affordability and corruption issues
that drove this election—or call his bluff. I’m ready to team up with any
Republican who is listening to the American people. But if Congressional
Republicans won’t join us to deliver relief for working families,
Democrats will do it without them.

Some Democrats have already argued that it’s wasted energy to send bold
policy changes to the Trump White House. I think that’s just plain wrong.
It would be a breach of faith with the people from South Carolina to
Texas, who voted for us to address costs and corruption, to spend the next
two years waiting for some future Democratic trifecta to hopefully deliver
meaningful change. Trump says he welcomes the nickname “Mr. Veto.” Well,
let’s test that out by passing legislation the American people support to
make life more affordable and our government less corrupt.

First, stop Trump’s war. Second, cut costs. Democrats have power on
spending bills that require our votes, and we should use it. No more
funding for a forever war with Iran. Cancel the looming cuts to health
insurance and nutrition benefits put in place by Republicans last summer.
The reconciliation budget process also allows us to pass big chunks of
legislation without a single Republican vote, so we should reverse
Republican health care cuts, expand health care coverage, and fund
universal child care. Third, pay for it by putting a little fairness back
in the system. We can start with canceling the tax breaks Trump and the
Republicans handed out to corporations, ultra-millionaires, and
billionaires.

Next, where Democrats agree reconciliation is not an option, like with
bills to ban stock trading by federal officials or crack down on Trump’s
corruption in plain sight, Democrats should put the bills up for a vote.
Let the Republicans decide if they want to stay tied to such corruption
and, if they do, then let’s clear away Senate filibuster rules and pass
the laws anyway.

Finally, accountability. Congress has the power to hold Donald Trump and
his cronies accountable for ripping off the American people to make
themselves richer. Big Tech CEOs, Wall Street executives, and giant
corporations should prepare to answer tough questions and face meaningful
consequences if they have broken the law.

Democrats won this election by claiming we are on the side of working
people, and working people are counting on us to deliver.

Americans need Democrats to deliver now, not in two years.

Hi Peter, I am feeling such immense amounts of relief and hope in the wake of the November 3rd election. I know we have our work cut out for us, and we certainly haven’t lost sight of our bigger goals, but we get to take time to celebrate our huge wins in 2026! This election, climate, clean energy, and affordability were on the ballot. And Oregonians were loud and clear with their votes – **delivering a mandate to our elected leaders for** **greater investment in affordable clean energy, climate action, and corporate accountability.** Join OLCV in celebrating these huge wins for Oregon:
* **100% of OLCV’s priority candidates in the 2026 general are WINNING or have WON!**
* We **re-elected Governor Tina Kotek**
* Eugene voters gave a resounding YES for climate resilience by **passing the Eugene Clean Energy Fund** (Measure 20-388)
* Pro-climate **Senator-elect Virginia Stapleton** has a strong lead to flip an anti-environment state senate seat
* We protected two pro-climate seats in the state senate by **re-electing Senator Deb Patterson and electing Denise Krause**
* We’re on track to protect 4 critical state house seats by **re-electing Reps. Lesly Muñoz and Lamar Wise** , and electing **Reps-elect Kori Rodley and Michael Sugar**
* The Democratic supermajority in the state house are poised to grow by two seats with **Rep-elect Michael Welsh** set to defeat a powerful anti-environment Republican incumbent, and **Rep-elect Hank Sanders** on track to win back the Hood River seat that Dems had held until 2022

I could go on and on about all of the OLCV-endorsed candidates who won Tuesday night, but I’ll leave it there. Thank you to all of you for supporting OLCV in this work. OLCV and OLCV PAC **invested over $730,000** into the 2026 primary and general elections. Together in 2026, OLCV staff and volunteers **knocked on nearly 13,000 doors** and **called over 4,500** Oregon voters. None of it is possible without our members and volunteers – THANK YOU! Take this time to celebrate these wins! Next, the real work begins. OLCV will need your continued partnership to ensure we hold our expanded supermajorities and governor accountable to the promises they’ve made. Voters overwhelmingly chose candidates who support advancing more affordability, clean energy to bring down energy costs, and those who will hold data centers accountable. We need our state legislature and governor to lead and deliver on those promises for Oregonians. clean_body: | | | Hi Peter, I am feeling such immense amounts of relief and hope in the wake of the November 3rd election. I know we have our work cut out for us, and we certainly haven’t lost sight of our bigger goals, but we get to take time to celebrate our huge wins in 2026! This election, climate, clean energy, and affordability were on the ballot. And Oregonians were loud and clear with their votes – delivering a mandate to our elected leaders for greater investment in affordable clean energy, climate action, and corporate accountability. Join OLCV in celebrating these huge wins for Oregon: 100% of OLCV’s priority candidates in the 2026 general are WINNING or have WON! We re-elected Governor Tina Kotek Eugene voters gave a resounding YES for climate resilience by passing the Eugene Clean Energy Fund (Measure 20-388) Pro-climate Senator-elect Virginia Stapleton has a strong lead to flip an anti-environment state senate seat We protected two pro-climate seats in the state senate by re-electing Senator Deb Patterson and electing Denise Krause We’re on track to protect 4 critical state house seats by re-electing Reps. Lesly Muñoz and Lamar Wise , and electing Reps-elect Kori Rodley and Michael Sugar The Democratic supermajority in the state house are poised to grow by two seats with Rep-elect Michael Welsh set to defeat a powerful anti-environment Republican incumbent, and Rep-elect Hank Sanders on track to win back the Hood River seat that Dems had held until 2022 I could go on and on about all of the OLCV-endorsed candidates who won Tuesday night, but I’ll leave it there. Thank you to all of you for supporting OLCV in this work. OLCV and OLCV PAC invested over $730,000 into the 2026 primary and general elections. Together in 2026, OLCV staff and volunteers knocked on nearly 13,000 doors and called over 4,500 Oregon voters. None of it is possible without our members and volunteers – THANK YOU! Take this time to celebrate these wins! Next, the real work begins. OLCV will need your continued partnership to ensure we hold our expanded supermajorities and governor accountable to the promises they’ve made. Voters overwhelmingly chose candidates who support advancing more affordability, clean energy to bring down energy costs, and those who will hold data centers accountable. We need our state legislature and governor to lead and deliver on those promises for Oregonians. name: Governor-elect Xavier Becerra Press
subject: RELEASE: Governor-Elect Becerra Meets with Legislative Leaders to Discuss Challenges Facing Californians, Budget & Legislative Priorities
body:
Becerra's meeting with legislative leaders marked Becerra’s first public appearance since winning Tuesday’s historic election.

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/xavierbecerra2026/11526_release-governor-elect-becerra-meets-with-legislative-leaders?e=8ded9d9094)

| | | | | | **For Immediate Release:** November 5, 2026
**CONTACT:** sebastian@xavierbecerra2026.com
---
| | **Governor-Elect Becerra Meets with Legislative Leaders to Discuss Challenges Facing Californians, Budget & Legislative Priorities**
---
| | | | | | | | | | [|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/eyEugFXtZS3?e=8ded9d9094&c2id=c340d588e0158113791a6a914911f3c6)
| [|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/EHwyb8wOgl6?e=8ded9d9094&c2id=c340d588e0158113791a6a914911f3c6)
| | | | | | | | | | | | **SACRAMENTO, CA –** Governor-elect Xavier Becerra met with legislative leaders on Thursday afternoon, sitting down with Senate President pro Tempore Monique Limón and Assembly Speaker Robert Rivas to discuss issues facing Californians, the state budget, and legislative priorities for 2027. Their meeting marked Becerra’s first public appearance since winning Tuesday’s historic election.
The leaders focused on four key areas: putting Proposition 1 (2026) bond dollars to work immediately so affordable housing projects can break ground without delay, protecting health coverage and access to care for Californians, bringing down energy costs, and keeping California at the forefront of the AI economy while protecting consumers and working families.
_“Californians are facing a broad array of affordability challenges, from the cost of housing to keeping their health coverage to paying their energy bills, and they expect us to tackle them,”_ said **Governor-elect Xavier Becerra**. _“Today was the first of many conversations with pro Tem Limón and Speaker Rivas about how we’ll work together to tackle these challenges. My mission as governor is straightforward: deliver a California we can afford and defend a California we can’t afford to lose.”_
_**"Voters didn't hand us a victory lap. They handed us a to-do list, and we are getting right to work,” said Assembly Speaker Robert Rivas. “With the largest Democratic Caucus in modern history, the Assembly will partner with Governor-elect Becerra and pro Tem Limón to rein in costs, build more housing, and protect health care. Voters gave us a mandate. Now it's on us to lead with courage."**_
_“Just days after the election, it is great to have a chance to sit down and discuss the work ahead for California. This election showed us that Californians and the nation would rather choose hope over division and fear. Now we must come together to deliver for every family who calls this state home,”_ said **Senate pro Tem Monique Limón** _. “Californians must be able to afford to see a doctor when they need one, keep a roof over their heads, and have food on their tables. Our children deserve to receive a quality education no matter their zip code or where they grow up. I am grateful to have the opportunity to work alongside Governor-elect Becerra and Speaker Rivas as we work together to meet these challenges head-on.”_
Governor-elect Becerra will be sworn in as California’s 41st governor in January.

My name is Eduardo Verastegui.

I am the producer of the film _Sound of Freedom_ and the founder of **Sound of Freedom Foundation. **

Years ago, I met the people who rescue children from trafficking.When I heard what is done to these children, I asked myself one question:

**_What if it were my child?_**

That question changed my life. And it is why I am writing to you today.

I want to tell you about a little girl. For her safety, we call her "Lola."
---

Lola's mother was a hardworking single mom, doing everything she could for her little girl.

Then she met a man online.

He promised her the moon and the stars.

He traveled a long way to get them. He said his parents had a beautiful home in California and they would all be cared for.

**It was a lie. **

Soon, Lola and her mother were missing.

One of our house parents moved fast. Investigators believed the family had reached southern Mexico.

So she sounded the alarm.

**She worked with authorities to get an AMBER Alert out with Lola 's picture and pushed her case into the public eye.**
---

And that very same day Lola was dropped off and left in front of child protective services.

Alone. Frightened.But alive.

Lola said her mother had died on the journey while she was crossing water. She could not swim.

We may never know what truly happened. But everything pointed to one terrible fear -- that this man groomed her mother to get to her daughter. And that he planned to take Lola into the United States to be trafficked.

**But he did not get to keep her. **

**We stopped him. **

Today, Lola is safe. She was reunited with her grandparents and adopted by her loving aunt.
---

Friend, this is not a movie.

About two million children are exploited in the sex trade around the world, according to the U.S. State Department.

**Two million. Each one made in the image of God. **

Our nation was built on the belief that every life has worth because God gave it.

**That truth does not let us look away.**

Jesus said, "_Let the little children come to me, and do not hinder them, for the kingdom of heaven belongs to such as these._ " (Matthew 19:14 NIV)

That is why **Sound of Freedom Foundation** exists -- **to stop the sale of God 's children. **

And Lola's story shows the most important truth of all: **children are found when people pay attention. **

Here is how you can join the fight today:

1\. **Stay alert.** Traffickers often start online with kindness and big promises.

2\. **If you see something, say something**. Read every AMBER Alert. Share it. If something feels wrong, call 911 or report a trafficking tip through **Sound of Freedom Foundation's** partner, Rescue America, at 1-833-599-3733.

3.**Make your first gift**. Help **Sound of Freedom Foundation** and our partners keep sounding the alarm.

I am the producer of the film Sound of Freedom and the founder of Sound of Freedom Foundation. Years ago, I met the people who rescue children from trafficking.When I heard what is done to these children, I asked myself one question: What if it were my child? That question changed my life. And it is why I am writing to you today. I want to tell you about a little girl. For her safety, we call her "Lola." Lola's mother was a hardworking single mom, doing everything she could for her little girl. Then she met a man online. He promised her the moon and the stars. He traveled a long way to get them. He said his parents had a beautiful home in California and they would all be cared for. It was a lie. Soon, Lola and her mother were missing. One of our house parents moved fast. Investigators believed the family had reached southern Mexico. So she sounded the alarm. She worked with authorities to get an AMBER Alert out with Lola 's picture and pushed her case into the public eye. And that very same day Lola was dropped off and left in front of child protective services. Alone. Frightened.But alive. Lola said her mother had died on the journey while she was crossing water. She could not swim. We may never know what truly happened. But everything pointed to one terrible fear -- that this man groomed her mother to get to her daughter. And that he planned to take Lola into the United States to be trafficked. But he did not get to keep her. We stopped him. Today, Lola is safe. She was reunited with her grandparents and adopted by her loving aunt. Friend, this is not a movie. About two million children are exploited in the sex trade around the world, according to the U.S. State Department. Two million. Each one made in the image of God. Our nation was built on the belief that every life has worth because God gave it. That truth does not let us look away. Jesus said, "Let the little children come to me, and do not hinder them, for the kingdom of heaven belongs to such as these. " (Matthew 19:14 NIV) That is why Sound of Freedom Foundation exists -- to stop the sale of God 's children. | | | | | | Republicans lost the Senate. Texas sent James Talarico to Washington over Ken Paxton. And Deb Haaland won the New Mexico governor’s race by double digits while getting fewer votes than every other Democrat on the ballot.
[We stayed up late ](https://us.list-manage.com/Cz2atglhtzN?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)with Jay McCleskey to make sense of it.
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/13jzLa_kmaT?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
| | **🔥 THE SENATE IS GONE, AND 2028 CAN’T FIX IT**
Paxton didn’t just lose Texas. He took Greg Abbott down with him.
Susan Collins lost Maine. El-Sayed is leading Michigan. Jay counts roughly ten Senate seats gone, and when Mark walks through the 2028 map state by state, there is almost nothing to take back.
One state made Mark say “we’re dead” before any of the big races were called. It’s not the one you’d guess.
---
| [STREAM NOW](https://us.list-manage.com/4Z_a3WCpW_F?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
---
| | **🚨 HAALAND WINS NEW MEXICO AND STILL FINISHES LAST**
She beat Gregg Hull by double digits. Then we pulled up the vote totals.
The Secretary of State candidate, someone Mark admits he’d never heard of, got more votes than the governor-elect. So did the Attorney General. So did the auditor and the treasurer.
**Jay has two words for what that means. Then Mark explains why the people gunning for her hardest aren’t Republicans.

****🏛️ JD VANCE MAY BE THE BIGGEST REPUBLICAN LOSER OF THE NIGHT**
He wasn’t on a ballot. Mark explains why that doesn’t matter.
A second lane to the 2028 nomination just opened. Jay has blunt advice for what Trump has to fix in the next two years, and Krysty reminds everyone who she called for the Democrats two years ago when they told her to calm down.

**🇺🇸 THE ONE RACE REPUBLICANS WON IN ALBUQUERQUE**
Nicole Chavez lost her son to street violence and turned it into a fight for tougher laws. Tonight she held her seat in a Democratic district against a trial lawyer running statewide TV ads for a state House race. How she did it is the lesson of the night.

Peter, Election Night was one for the history books 🌊 And you helped make it happen. We have secured the most Democratic statehouse flips in a single election since 1974. The DLCC made sweeping gains with over **500 state legislative flips** and at least **twelve statehouse majorities flipped red-to-blue.** Democrats now control at least 20 trifectas, including new ones in AZ, MN, MI, PA, NV, and WI. This is the largest shift in statehouse power since the Republican Wave in 2010. And Peter, you should be incredibly proud of the role you played in making it possible. Thanks to the dedication of this grassroots team, **over 50% of Americans now live in a state with a Democratic legislative majority.** That means millions more people with the opportunity for stronger leadership and progress on issues that hit close to home. As we bask in the excitement of a blue wave, we recognize that the work is not over. As votes continue to be counted and recounts expected, state Democrats are counting on us to keep fighting for every last seat. You helped make this historic night possible. We did it together. And this victory belongs to you. I ran for Congress because I believe government should work for working people. I believe everyone deserves a fair shot, a voice at the table, and a representative that will fight for them. And now, you’re sending me back to the other Washington — with a strong Democratic majority in the House! **_We’ve got work to do, and I’m ready to get started._** We need to make healthcare more affordable. We need to lower costs for working families. We need to protect reproductive freedom. We need to defend our democracy and stand up for everyone who’s been targeted by this administration, end the chaos and the corruption. _And now, we actually have a chance to turn these priorities into action._ I never take for granted the trust you’ve placed in me. I’ll keep listening to my neighbors across WA-06, showing up in our communities and fighting for the people who sent me to Congress. **Thank you for believing in this campaign and trusting me with the opportunity to keep fighting for you. clean_body: Friend, We face powerful foes today who are willing to do anything to dominate America, even if it means destroying democracy. The Left's so-called principles are utterly incompatible with those that are the bedrock of our constitutional republic. They're incompatible with individual liberty and free will. They're incompatible with the Judeo-Christian belief system under which this nation was founded. At a time when the very values that make America great are under attack, we must continue to stand strong. We must make sure our fellow citizens understand the seriousness of this situation. I'll never stop defending America, our Constitution, our free market economy, and our Judeo-Christian traditions. And I'll never stop calling out the leftists who want to tear our country down. I know you won't either! I do a lot of things. But one of the most important things I do is work with my colleagues at Landmark Legal Foundation. Landmark Legal Foundation is on a mission. They 're here to protect liberty, property rights, constitutionalism . . . in other words, what you read in the Declaration of Independence and the Constitution. And now, I'd love you to stand with me in supporting this outstanding organization. The Left aren't saviors of democracy.They 're Marxists. And what they're doing is destroying the country. They fight desperately to undermine our election processes and, if elections go against them, they use the courts to obstruct the policies We the People voted for. They persecute their opponents, like when the Biden In justice Department waged relentless lawfare against Trump and his allies. Leftists focus so much energy on the justice system - to control it, to contort it, to use it to promote their insanely radical agenda. Again and again, they turn to rogue left-wing judges to usurp the Constitution and undermine America's founding principles. We must not be silent while these leftists destroy our republic from within. That 's why it's so great to have Landmark Legal Foundation take them on! I love these guys. I've been part of the Landmark family for over three decades . . . as president for 20 years, then Chairman of the Board, and now Chairman Emeritus. These briefs present the strongest possible argument for the constitutional position and help convince judges to do the right thing. In 2024, Landmark made a historic winning argument that special prosecutor Jack Smith lacked the legal authority to target Donald Trump in the classified documents probe. The judge in the case echoed Landmark's arguments in her decision and delivered a huge win over the Left 's lawfare. Landmark also fights to defend free, fair elections. For example, Landmark filed a supportive brief in another key election integrity case. With Bost v. Illinois Board of Elections , they're helping challenge unfair vote-by-mail procedures. Here, Illinois Congressman Mike Bost sued the Illinois Board of Elections over their practice of counting mail-in ballots received after Election Day. Such counting delays results and opens the door for abuse. When the Supreme Court agreed, it marked a major victory for free, fair elections. But this is not the last fight! This isn't political . . . it 's about the Constitution! My Landmark friends are on the frontlines of the battle to preserve our country. They're a vital part of the conservative, constitutionalist force fighting for our country today. subject: The count that doesn't add up
body:

Voter Reference FoundationEvery election's numbers should add up, and most states could make sure they do. ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌

Patriot,

Here's a question that ought to have a simple answer: how many ballots were cast in your state in November 2024?

Our research team at the Voter Reference Foundation set out to answer it three ways, using nothing but official government sources.

First, the total ballots cast that the state itself certified.

Second, the number of registered voters the state's own records show as having voted.

Third, the figure the state reported to the federal Election Assistance Commission.

In a system running the way it should, those three numbers match, or come close with a clear, documented explanation for any gap.

In nearly every state we looked at, they didn't match.In some places all three disagreed with each other at the same time, meaning no two official sources could agree on how many ballots were cast in the same election.

I spent years running a business before I got into this work. If my company kept three sets of records that disagreed on how many customers we'd served, somebody would be explaining it to me before lunch.

The biggest of these problems surprised even me. Most states never save a certified copy of the voter roll as it stood on Election Day.

The voter list a living database. People move, pass away, and register every single day, and the file keeps getting edited in place. By the time anyone outside government can get a copy, it's a different list from the one that existed when the polls closed. The starting point you'd need to check the count is simply gone.

Why should that bother you? Because a gap nobody can explain never stays quiet for long. When trust in our elections is already stretched thin, an unexplained number gets filled in with whatever story people are inclined to believe. Accurate, checkable numbers are what make honest results hard to attack.

Here’s the encouraging part. The fix is simple, and it doesn’t take a new law.

Election offices just need to save a copy of the voter list the night the polls close and report one plain number for how many people voted. Then anyone could line the two up and see whether they match.

Most election offices already have this information. They just don’t make it public.

On November 3rd, Americans in every state will cast ballots in the 2026 midterms. Unless something changes, most of those states will once again edit their rolls in place and move on, and the chance to check that election's count will slip away with it.

We want to be in position to press election offices to adopt these fixes, and to run this same comparison on the 2026 results as soon as the data is available.

I'd like to ask you to do two things before then...

The first costs nothing. Contact your county election office and ask them a single question: "Will you keep a certified copy of the voter roll as it stands when the polls close on Election Day?" It's a fair, polite question, and it's exactly the kind a local official ought to hear from the voters they serve.

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABl7ImQiOjUwNTIsInQiOjc2NywicyI6MTJ9AAwAAAAAA_b9YuiVNQocRo36oAlskUQcYdBtdYTgod4lkE_M0ZDXPQgEtl2n3KlMIAO4oYVsT7tLPGzBhmaCs5I95E5yhXlSsXig4ltr7bf4kvOfXA
The second is to stand with us today with a gift of $35, or whatever you can manage. Your support keeps the records on Voteref.com current, so there's something reliable to check the count against. It funds the research behind reports like this one. And it lets us keep pressing election offices on these fixes before and after November.

When those three sets of numbers finally agree, nobody will have to take anyone's word for the result, including mine.

Trust, but verify.

subject: My brother could die in prison
body:

| Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund My brother defended himself... now he’s charged with murder | | | | | Dear Fellow Patriot,[](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABl7ImQiOjUwNTIsInQiOjc2NywicyI6MTJ9AAwAAAAAA_inDN-0Mh0Tx_aLRK_hn5DX4Q1Rwp12iC0LUJS7LFuuL3QBgHsMK7YHSyOgwy3LFPCBPoscAZwsIelzmV7iiW-m72ZbPeGzF9E6z5Cv1A) Never in a million years did I think I would be writing an email like this. [_**But the truth is, my family and I are out of options. And you're our only hope.**_](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABl7ImQiOjUwNTIsInQiOjc2NywicyI6MTJ9AAwAAAAAA_inDN-1uFtbMZ8yxIpN28uJh_OWe5pxk_yodUkandvyh3gvX7aWhV-se82_TMcKTd9TQtXj52MiS5jbI2NKpN22VvdBYt1KqXyOfU-k9w)
---
| | | [](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABl7ImQiOjUwNTIsInQiOjc2NywicyI6MTJ9AAwAAAAAA_inDN-2r_xe61k5cSPUJfDSOcUmROAc2lq1PycupcLduxZWxOdksONDAHQwN-4fVKzv75xoPHUwvW9pLjgJcV-FO1MHCnXWDouiCwXBLQ)
---
This is a photo of my brother, Anthony DeLustro. Anthony spent more than 20 years serving citizens as an NYPD cop, hunting down dangerous drug dealers and busting up drug dens. On 9/11, he helped evacuate hundreds of people from one of the buildings just before it collapsed. Since that day, he's been battling cancer and Ground Zero Lung from the toxic fumes. We really thought Anthony had been through the worst of it. **Then he took a police job in a small South Carolina town so he could spend his golden years close to his grandkids.** How could I have known he was about to face the greatest danger of his life? I'm not talking about a drug dealer or a terrorist or even cancer... **...but a local prosecutor hellbent on destroying my brother for defending himself when he was the victim of a road rage incident.** Let me explain. The day Anthony was attacked, he was off duty. He and his wife had stopped for lunch after spending the morning at a "Coffee With A Cop" community event. As they tried to pull out of the crowded restaurant parking lot, another driver jumped out of his car and began screaming threats at my brother. **Anthony tried to calm him down.** **But the man attacked him, striking him over and over.** Anthony pulled out his badge and told the man he was under arrest. Instead of complying, the man knocked the badge out of Anthony's hand, got in his car, and tried to flee... ...dragging my brother with his vehicle and running over his legs. In that moment, Anthony knew he was about to be crushed to death in front of his own wife. So he fired a single shot into his attacker's arm, bringing the car to a stop. Anthony's quick thinking saved his life. But the road rage driver who attacked him died at the scene. When I got the call that Anthony had been assaulted and was in the hospital with serious injuries, I was so relieved he was alive. **But my relief turned into shock when my brother was arrested and charged with murder.** He hadn't even recovered from his injuries when the local prosecutor dragged him in front of a judge and had him locked up in jail. And now he's facing up to **30 years** in prison. Anthony is 64 years old. If he's convicted... **...he'll likely spend the rest of his life locked up - and die in prison - for defending himself.** **[That's why I'm writing you - someone I've never met - to ask you to help my brother.](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABl7ImQiOjUwNTIsInQiOjc2NywicyI6MTJ9AAwAAAAAA_inDN-3ZKA13aRfBjUlGEVPtZ9bwxWgDZXnHReHHk4wL1HEJD6qiAkTV0snuN4lkej5YWXQjg10VOyxXGes86qac8W4BD5yxxlpy7dkuQ)** Anthony doesn't deserve this. He served as a cop for four decades and never once faced discipline. He has a spotless record full of awards and commendations. Several years ago, Anthony and his wife took their two granddaughters into their home. They've been raising them ever since. You can imagine the pain it's caused these poor girls to have their grandfather locked up and treated like a common criminal. We were almost out of hope. And then we found out about the **Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund**. LELDF is a national group that's helped dozens of innocent officers clear their names when they're wrongly accused by radical prosecutors. And they've agreed to help Anthony too. Not only are they getting my brother the legal defense he deserves - they're also raising money to pay for the best attorneys and expert witnesses available. Which brings me to the reason I wrote you today: **[Will you help my brother fight these unjust charges by donating to the LELDF?](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABl7ImQiOjUwNTIsInQiOjc2NywicyI6MTJ9AAwAAAAAA_inDN-457S1Y4gu29snKrGxDG0O3nVH1zdlEFNl8PjcYRT4tKBIPLgqHnQjF2FvlIwFlKAzjso17hTVTYPJ8NevSc2RNUuWxeOef3wlYw)** The legal bills are already overwhelming. And we haven't even gotten to trial. Anthony and his wife have already drained almost their entire life's savings fighting to free him. So any amount you can give today will help. And because LELDF is a non-profit organization, your gift is completely tax-deductible. **Whatever you can afford to give, I'm asking you to please make your gift today.** After four decades serving his community, the cancer, and the injuries from his attack, Anthony deserves to spend his retirement years in peace with his family - NOT locked up behind bars for the rest of his life. But that's exactly what will happen unless patriots like you step up on his behalf. Thank you for taking the time to read my email today. **Thank you in advance for making your tax-deductible gift to help Anthony fight to clear his name.** And please, keep my brother in your prayers.
---
| | | **_Frank DeLustro_**
---
P.S. Anthony didn’t know it at the time, but the road-rage maniac who attacked him had a criminal record. Maybe that’s why he was so eager to flee the scene after my brother arrested him. **Please help save Anthony from spending the rest of his life behind bars. Make a tax-deductible gift of any amount to the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund right away.**
---

name: Houston Gaines
subject: Thank you!
body:
I'm honored to be your next Congressman and ready to get to work!
| | | | | [](https://a89bm49ab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001HmE8nptLBWKzjZ-L-I02CT7A2j8e1MmSp11G0gB0SvH47FrpNcwefSTZTjeS8nftj35Wp6QiKrNrRAjGAGZ5lEi1gtdakxbNdimydiJD5rt5Bqe54yAkiWmpyOoBb28rd0Hg6yVoqfUcdWdtlv8I4SWNF2Bf-ifJ&c=3kPHvIo-sy_kSs-iFY3WNRsNHPIK08pEb35uEToLrhL-vowfhN5Tsg==&ch=JwCu6gpzo926eq-ZdHWKehCt75iRFRQ5i2oAH4PfcCLxAJP8nWK2Ng==)
---
| What a week!
On Tuesday night, the people of Georgia's 10th District gave me the honor of a lifetime: the opportunity to represent our community in the United States Congress.
Over the last year and a half, we've traveled tens of thousands of miles, visited communities all across our district, and met so many incredible people. From the beginning, this campaign was about bringing a get-it-done mentality to Washington.
And we couldn't have done it without you. Every door knocked, call made, sign put up, event hosted, contribution made, and prayer offered helped get us here. To our incredible campaign staff, county captains, interns, and volunteers: thank you. We outworked everybody, and this victory belongs to everyone who was a part of this campaign. I especially want to thank my family. Most importantly, my wife, Gabi, has been right beside me through it all. No one sacrifices more during a campaign than a candidate's spouse, and I'm incredibly grateful for her love and support. I also want to thank my parents and siblings for their countless hours of help throughout this campaign.
---
| | | |
---
Serving you in the Georgia House has been an incredible honor. I'm proud of the results we've delivered, and I'll always be grateful for the opportunity you gave me to serve. Now, I'm ready to take that same approach to Congress. Washington has plenty of politicians who seem more interested in becoming celebrities than getting results. I'm going there to get things done.

Of course, while we celebrated a great victory here in the 10th District, Tuesday was a disappointing night in many other parts of our state and country. We have serious challenges ahead, and the fight to protect our values and rebuild for the future begins now. While my time in the State House is coming to an end, I have every intention of staying engaged in that fight here at home. But that's a conversation for another day.

Today, I simply want to say thank you.

Thank you for believing in me. Thank you for standing with our family. And thank you for giving me the opportunity to continue serving the place I've always called home.

I promise to work every single day to continue to earn the trust you've placed in me.

Your friend,
Houston
| |
---
| |
---
| |
---
| P.S. If you have a yard sign, we're happy to pick it up, or you're welcome to save it for the next election! We're working hard to collect our larger signs and hope to finish within the next week.
---

## Record Flooding Swamps Copperhill
Tennessee [activated Level 4 emergency operations](https://email.editor.thetennesseeflyover.com/c/eJykkL3upCAUxZ8GOwwg6lhQbGM3225prnAdySJM4CqZt984xb7AvzjVSX7n489zeYIPPr5-w4GGaFsi1hKQCPOS0abstpCSKwUjEBYEsikuSqiBS8nFsIAlf-GioXFmVXICbRs0cpy6aeg6LZvdbNPgRjUqiVpgb1GvatOA07CpYXVWNN7cQCnFrUf_aEf3mDoA29tOdHoVTAt0nlJuaUfCGLEUxC180oW5telogtmJ3oV1v5iamZprrW0tx3WbTM03n6lZSqZm0TM1A2YPgWcs9sTCz-gwV_hwdyLfApSdf3f7-OIlnbQjFOL_k_mOGQuvOxCvyP_GVJmam2zcu_oQfBlGpsXrAB--7eiH115G_QsAAP__69qP7g) as crews carried out aerial and swiftwater rescues in Polk County, where the Ocoee River crested at a record 18.05 feet at Copperhill early Thursday. The crest [topped the all-time record](https://email.editor.thetennesseeflyover.com/c/eJykkLGu6yAMhp-GbKnAkKQZGO7C1rveMXLASZAoVGC1um9_lFY65wHO4MnW5__7_92WG8YU8_4X72SZtyXTqyViprpU8qWGLZUSWqOMTI2QfckLSBh7pXo5Lug5Pmkx2AW7gprR-I6smmY9j1ob1R1W-kmtqwLtwxxwBDOHSUtJahsnaQbsoj2BSslzrsP1MoXrrBH94LXUZpXCSAqRS73wQUw5U2tEW_pfnlQvvty7ZA_mRxP6jwAnwL0I-fjsBLgTL8ApJcDJQYA7LX-uBLiPa78lbEf_Vo55779f9TuVukfsqg2PV0wptnESRu53jOkdgH_Z3tPCVwAAAP___jiD6g) at Copperhill in 80 years of recordkeeping, according to the National Weather Service. Floodwaters also swamped neighboring McCaysville, Georgia, and Copperhill closed the city and urged people to stay away from downtown. The flooding forced bridge and school closures in two small towns, home to fewer than 500 people in Copperhill and about 1,000 in McCaysville.
## Blackburn Lays Out Affordability Plan
Governor-elect Marsha Blackburn [outlined an affordability agenda](https://email.editor.thetennesseeflyover.com/c/eJykkD2OrDAQhE9jMpDdmL_AwUvI5qUbosZuGGuNPbJ7QHP7FXuFDSoq6avS9_VYHuiDj_t_PMgwb0ukqwRiprxksim7LaTkSqGITIWQbYoLSOhrpWrZL2jZn7RorJxZQU2obUVGDVM79W2rVfU0WuGqJwf9oPpxgJU2CZPVmgZrQduu8uYGKiXvjN3YDG6cWkTb2Va2epVCS3KeU274SUwxUilEW_ikk3Jj01EF82R-FdH-EzALmK_raq5ynHcpYL75AmalBMyyEzCvAe33-s6xTm8OPlKpcdtSdrj64PlT407RYb3fCzHlmgJZFjBX2bjX5UPwpR-ElvuBPvxe4D_6Ow38BAAA__90DoUv) that includes eliminating the state's 4% grocery tax and capping property taxes. She also plans to tackle child care and housing costs, and says she'll start working on the issues during her transition ahead of her January inauguration. Blackburn, the first woman elected governor of Tennessee, [pledged a "conservative reset"](https://email.editor.thetennesseeflyover.com/c/eJykkDvOpDAQhE8DGcgvXoGDTchm0w1R024Gaxo8snsHze1X7BX-oKRPKqlUVX8eywMix_P5Gw7yItty0lWYRCgvmTDlsHFKoRQ6QagQCKZzMcr0jdaN6hdAiR9aHNTBr0ZP4LAmr4fJTr21Tte7HzFMm8UQ1DRqXDXqTaluUNPaD9ZZXUd_B2qtbo3d2A5hnCwAdmiVdauqnKIQJeVWdhI6TyqFaONv-lBuMR01-13kXSr7qzJzZebrutov7CndbmXme1Zl5nfiKBFvhCwRmW5cGfC1_s1nI_Ci0hBk_jZMEJoMSI3SWmnbOdfucnCdfXhfkTmWfqiceh4Q-X8J-eGDH2_-BQAA__8byIYj) for the state during the campaign. Tennessee is one of the few states that still taxes groceries, though lawmakers approved a three-month grocery tax holiday in 2023.
## 6 Bear Cubs Graduate to the Wild
Appalachian Bear Rescue [released six cubs into the wild](https://email.editor.thetennesseeflyover.com/c/eJykkL2O4zAQg59G7hToz7JduLjG3V57pTEajTcCJlIgKTH27Q_OK2zBigRBfv--9i9InPL3X3jQ2vuxZzobU-9U90pYajy4lNgaZejUCDqWvBtlvNRaKr8D9vSm3cEQ12D0Ag4HWvW02MVb6_RwX423U3A0Kr-gV-MRjVYeJ6estujNPKT1KtRaXZrH-TbFebEAOKJV1gUlnKKYeqm3fqdOOVNrRAf_lDfVG5bHwOu992cT9o8wmzDbeZ63M6SPKcwGtSdkEma7_gmzcUFgYbYH1J93YiYZuLxyv7LPJzDgPUGWgaDKSg1fJCsxQaMm8RWaTLkXeSaOwmyjllPQ8-xGlHGmRbpDOQnLhNL6Q0dUbgHyQ13j80zMqflJOPX9gMSf9f2X6N-r-R8AAP__ZpuXeQ) Tuesday after all of them passed their physical exams with top marks. It's a milestone for the Townsend rescue, which [reopened in June](https://email.editor.thetennesseeflyover.com/c/eJykkL2urCAUhZ8GOww_jmJBcRu7ue0tzRa2IwkDBvZI5u1vPK9wirWqlS8r37_n-oQQQ3r9hTdaon1N2GpEIixrQZeL32POvlZMQFgRyOW0KqFGLiUX4wqOwoXrAJ23m5IzDK5DK6dZz6PWg-wOu-ttctro2U9-0lKhMOPDgNz9OGpjoAv2Bkop7piH6SdvZg3gHk4LPWyCDQJ9oFx6OpAwJawVcY_ffGHpXX530R5EZ2X6D1MLU0trrW9XpJ4uppYbz9Qi7pKGqQXOEyK4I0DiG0LhBav7IC-YT0yVt0AHT9h4-USsHHbCwr_3EJLnwA-IO3cx109BppauWH-2EGOo48QG8XpDiD-_6JdSL6v-BwAA__9lP4xH) after a year-and-a-half shutdown that followed the euthanizing of 13 cubs with pneumonia in December 2024. The rescue's first cub back, [nicknamed Hemlock Bear](https://email.editor.thetennesseeflyover.com/c/eJyk0L2uozAQBeCnMd0g_5AABcU2dHfbLdHEHoK1Ezuy52Ll7VfsK9xipCmOPh2dP1_bF0aO6fkbX7SI7FuiVplEqGyFfC5h55xDrZRQqBKKz2mz2t7BGND3Db3Ek7YBu7A8rJlx8B0tZpzdfHduMN2xYLA0DeN8mz266bbrEYN1uzG0T8bt1MXlAo3R1023qR_DNDtEf_NOu-Gh1aApRMmll4OEUqJaiXb-5JNK7_Or4-UQeVflfim7Kru21vp2svRyKrtevLKrHq9_VnZFZpAjVmhYoeUiB0SBS4MPYYEDeYdXZI45QcjMWCowChXA9xsZ_RExwePKFqr-myBWEPwb0xP896MCPjEmZdeuLOHdLqneRzXo5wsj_68sP9z7XOy_AAAA__-Uf5bv), arrived in July weighing just seven pounds, and four orphaned Washington County cubs joined in August. Under new state rules, cubs are released individually or in small groups once they reach about 40 pounds, instead of in large winter releases.

Hey, my fellow angry Democrats. After this week's historic election, I sat down with my friend, State Representative Eric Synenberg, to talk about what comes next.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/f29ebc37-8a7a-4b5a-98e4-eabb95c177aa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
State Representative Eric Synenberg
Eric is an attorney and former Beachwood City Council member who first won election to the Ohio House in 2024 with 79.2% of the vote. This week, he won reelection with approximately 83.7%, according to unofficial returns.
He represents Ohio's 21st House District: Beachwood, Euclid, Lyndhurst, South Euclid, University Heights, and part of Cleveland, including Collinwood. He is also a Jewish American and a member of the Ohio Jewish Caucus.
**Before we even get into the election conversation, he wanted to give Collinwood some appreciation.**

People hear Beachwood and make assumptions about his district, but the communities he represents cover a wide range of incomes and experiences.
Then we got into the question facing Democrats across Ohio: **You 've won. What are you going to do with it?**
* * *
## What Were Voters Telling Us?
**Matt:** Do you think this was a mandate for Democratic policies, or a rejection of Trump and the Republican Party? What did voters tell you?
**Eric:** We have to go by data and outcomes. Trump won in 2024. Independents and Republicans felt he should get a second term, and he won. We're not a party of election deniers.
I personally believe his second term has been the worst presidency in modern times, if not the history of our country. His second presidency was different from his first from day one, in the way he tried to fundamentally change our country.
Look at DOGE, the major changes to the federal government, tariffs, and the big budget bill. There are consequences that have already come down and consequences that will continue next year, particularly around healthcare and SNAP.
I think voters realized how bad Trump is and how few members of his party stood up to him. This result was a year in the making.
**Matt:** You saw this coming before this election?
**Eric:** I knew this was going to be a good year for Democrats on election night in 2025. We saw Democrats winning school board, city council, township trustee, and village council races in suburban areas that had historically been Republican.
We were all surprised by what happened this week, but the basis for it was already there.
We still don't know everything about where the electorate is politically. Are they more Republican or more Democratic? We know they don't like Trump and this current Republican Party.
* * *
## What Changes When Republicans Can't Override the Governor?
**Matt:** Republicans still control the legislature, but they can no longer override a Democratic governor's veto on their own. What does that mean?
**Eric:** Before, they could override it. That hasn't happened constantly. In the almost two years I've been there, it happened once, on the property-tax legislation. But the threat was always there.
The more important part, in my opinion, is that in a two-party system, if you're being objective, fair, and reasonable, you should want that pendulum to keep swinging back and forth.
Think about the Ohio Supreme Court. We should want a court that's closely divided, where sometimes Republicans have the majority and sometimes Democrats do. When it's overwhelmingly one-sided, people going before the court feel like they already know which way their case is going to go. That's not fair.
The same principle applies to the legislature. One party being in power for decades isn't healthy. Even if Democrats were the ones in power for 20 years, I would say the same thing.
So yes, we're in a much healthier place as a democracy now than we were last week. But we still have to see what comes out of it. I hope we'll see that healthier balance reflected in the legislation that gets passed.
* * *
## What Can You Deliver in the First 100 Days?
**Matt:** People on my Facebook page are asking about funding schools, the voucher program, healthcare, and SNAP. What can you realistically deliver in the first 100 days?
**Eric:** We need more time. Give us 200 days.
**Matt:** Okay, we'll give you 200 days. First negotiation done. haha
**Eric:** I say that because the state operating budget is our most important document. It prioritizes everything for the following two-year cycle, and it has to pass by June 30.
That's when we'll really know how the funding priorities have changed. Have we gone back to the Fair School Funding Plan? Do we have a fairer tax system?
Our income-tax system is skewed to favor wealthier Ohioans. We should return to a progressive income-tax structure.
**Matt:** The argument for tax cuts is that people keep more money and spend it. Does the state recover some of that through sales taxes?
**Eric:** Without the numbers in front of me, I can't say.
But the state is in a solid financial position. We get monthly and annual reports, and typically the state brings in more than its projections. We also have the rainy-day fund.
The point is, we can afford the Fair School Funding Plan. Returning to a more progressive income-tax structure is one part of that.
* * *
## What Happens to Families Using Vouchers?
**Matt:** A lot of families have been using vouchers for several years. They've made decisions about where their children go to school. Would you advocate eliminating the program? What happens to those families?
**Eric:** I don't believe in radical change, one way or the other.
First, we're still dealing with a Republican-controlled legislature. But even if we could do it, even if Democrats won all 99 House seats, I would say: Let's make changes or phase it out over years. Don't just totally cut it.
There are reforms that I believe even advocates for the voucher program would concede on.
**Matt:** But now you have Amy Acton, and she has line-item veto power. Republicans will have to negotiate. Doesn't that create the possibility for substantial changes?
**Eric:** My concern is more on the Fair School Funding side, on the public-school side, than totally cutting vouchers. I wouldn't anticipate ending the voucher program overnight.
We need to increase the state's support for public schools. There are different ways to start changing vouchers, too.
We have a bill pending that would prevent families making more than $500,000 a year from receiving them. Currently, even at that income, families can still receive money.
And remember, public districts still have responsibilities for students attending private schools, including transportation. We're subsidizing these schools while public schools continue carrying those obligations.
* * *
## Do We Still Want Fair Maps After Winning?
**Matt:** Democrats just gained seats under these maps. Why mess with a good thing? Would you still support changing them?
**Eric:** Yes. I support a constitutional amendment and an independent commission so this is actually done fairly.
I personally heard Amy Acton say several times on the campaign trail that supporting another redistricting effort would be a priority.
I want it on the ballot in 2027.
**Matt:** Could that produce new districts for 2028?
**Eric:** I don't believe it would get done in time for new districts in 2028. Whether it could happen before the next census cycle depends on how the amendment is written. I don't know what that language will look like yet.
**Matt:** Republicans will point to Democratic states and say gerrymandering goes both ways.
**Eric:** And it does. But just because another state does it the wrong way doesn't mean we should do it to balance things out.
An independent commission should draw the lines.
You're also never going to have 99 competitive House districts. Some communities are overwhelmingly Democratic, and others are overwhelmingly Republican.
But even after a very good election for Democrats, there is still work to be done.
* * *
## What Should Ohio's Democrats Do in Washington?
**Matt:** Ohio is sending more Democrats to Congress. What do you want them to do to help Ohio and help you do your job?
**Eric:** Look at the Problem Solvers Caucus, which includes Republicans and Democrats. There are commonsense policy ideas and solutions that should be implemented but haven't been because Washington is so partisan.
Let's find things we can actually get done. Look at how many of those proposals became law in previous Congresses, and let's improve on that.
There's also appropriations. We support applications from cities, nonprofit groups, and other organizations seeking federal money. That's one way we work together.
But the biggest issue is affordability.
**Matt:** What does addressing affordability look like to you?
**Eric:** I tend to look more at incomes than just expenses. Prices have gone up, especially over the last several years. Gas, groceries, construction materials.
But if you're making a million dollars a year, you can absorb that. The fundamental issue is income inequality and the gap between the average worker and the people at the top.
For lower-income and middle-class families, life has become too hard. This is not sustainable.
Is the answer the minimum wage? More relief for people at the lower end? Something has to give.
The biggest thing I want from Congress is to reverse the changes in the big budget bill: healthcare, SNAP, the coverage changes, and the additional paperwork people will have to deal with.
That would be my most important message to Ohio's congressional Democrats.
* * *
## Where Is the Line Between Criticism and Antisemitism?
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/38ee38b5-dda7-46e6-ae43-d4888306548d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**Matt:** You recently strongly criticized a "friend's" post saying "Fuck Israel." Tell about how that crossed the line.
**Eric:** This was a high school and college friend. I saw it and thought: This is beyond the pale. This is not acceptable.
People don't always realize how that language comes across to Jewish people. Our religion, identity, history, and trauma are connected to Israel.
To me, that statement goes beyond criticizing the government.
**Matt:** Then how should people criticize what is happening in Israel and Gaza? How do you have that conversation without making our Jewish neighbors feel attacked?
**Eric:** Name the individuals. Criticize the current Israeli government.
It's like having a conversation about Trump and American politics without being anti-American. There's a way to do it.
I'm not defending everything Israel has done in its history or modern history. I think continued settlement expansion in the West Bank is unconscionable.
Some of the things Netanyahu, Ben-Gvir, and Smotrich have done are abhorrent. I don't believe those actions represent what Israel or Jewish values should be.
**Matt:** On the other side, do you also see a rise in Islamophobia?
**Eric:** One hundred percent. It's undeniable, and it's wrong. Period.
I also want to see Muslim public figures condemn extremists acting in their religion's name. I have no problem criticizing people on my side, and I want to see that willingness from others.
Those are separate issues. Islamophobia should be condemned, and public figures should also be willing to condemn bad actors within their own communities.
* * *
## How Do Voters Hold You Accountable?
**Matt:** Democrats have the opportunity now. We've talked about school funding, the budget, and redistricting. How should people hold you accountable if those promises aren't fulfilled?
**Eric:** We're back before voters in two years, and statewide officials are back in four. That's the accountability.
We spend all this time talking about where the electorate is and what's popular. Every two and four years, we actually find out.
If the Fair School Funding Plan doesn't get reimplemented, that's not good. We won't have the same support from teachers that we had this time.
**Matt:** So voters get to judge whether you did the job, and you have to answer for it at the next election.
**Eric:** Yes.
Democrats have more power, a budget negotiation ahead, and promises people will remember.
