body:
Our Accomplishments Remain. Looking Beyond the Collateral Damage.

| | | | | [|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/_PU26PVb7xO?e=a7ab36849c&c2id=b6e4918ecaa4a9e494d38fc9e6fde211)
| | | | | | Dear Friends,I want to sincerely thank each of you for your support throughout this campaign. Your encouragement, hard work, generosity, and belief in our mission made this journey possible.Over the past few months, our supporters helped us write more than 10,000 personalized postcards to targeted voters, deliver campaign literature, text and call our neighbors, and, of course, several of you helped drive our campaign team from house to house during the final weeks of the campaign.**THANK YOU!** We would not have been as successful without the support of so many helping hands.What many people never see are the sacrifices made behind the scenes of a campaign. Weekends disappeared. Family time was postponed. Long days turned into late nights.Whether you displayed a yard sign, hosted an event, made phone calls, sent text messages, knocked on doors, donated, prayed for our team, or simply encouraged a neighbor to vote, you became part of something far greater than a single election campaign. **For that, I will always be grateful.** In a time when so many people feel disconnected from the political process, you proved that civic engagement still matters. You reminded me that Arizona is filled with people who care deeply about their communities and are willing to step forward when their state needs them.The election results are now in, and while the outcome may not have been exactly what we hoped for, I am incredibly proud of what we accomplished together. We brought people together, elevated important issues, inspired meaningful conversations, and built relationships that will continue to strengthen our community. Most importantly, we demonstrated the power of people uniting around a shared vision for a better future.This campaign was never just about one election. It was about creating positive change, giving a voice to our community, and delivering meaningful results for Arizona families.For instance, while I was serving in the House, I led the fight to eliminate Arizona's food tax and rental tax because families should not be taxed on necessities. While Washington's inflation policies drove up the cost of groceries and gas, I remained focused on policies Arizona could control to reduce costs and create economic opportunity for hard working families.At a time when inflation was driving up the cost of groceries, housing, and everyday essentials, Arizona Republican legislators worked to reduce the tax burden on hardworking Arizonans and put more money back into family budgets. I fought to make our state more affordable by reducing unnecessary regulations, expanding workforce opportunities, supporting small businesses, and advancing housing reforms designed to increase supply and lower barriers to homeownership.Yet, despite these accomplishments and the progress we achieved together, Tuesday's election reminded us that broader political forces can sometimes overshadow local results. In many ways, our campaign became collateral damage in a much larger battle. While the outcome was not what we hoped for, I remain proud of the work we accomplished, the principles we defended, and the lives we improved along the way.Elections come and go, but the laws we passed, the taxpayers we helped, the victims we protected, and the opportunities we created for Arizona families will hopefully continue to make a difference for years to come.Sadly, out-of-state labor organizations invested more than $699,000 attacking my successful bipartisan legislative record and spreading lies and misinformation throughout our district.Despite the negativity directed at our campaign, we chose a different path. We focused on a successful track record, bipartisan solutions, results instead of rhetoric, comparison pieces, and my dedicated public service over personal attacks. While others concentrated on division, we concentrated on delivering results.That approach has guided my public service from day one. Whether serving in the House or Senate, my goal was never to seek headlines. My goal was to solve problems, help constituents, and leave Arizona better than I found it.Over these last three legislative sessions, I had the privilege of advancing legislation that strengthened victims' rights, improved public safety, increased government transparency, expanded economic opportunity, and protected some of our most vulnerable citizens. Together, we helped pass dozens of meaningful reforms that have made a lasting impact across Arizona.From 2024 through 2026, my legislative efforts focused on delivering practical, common-sense solutions in several key issue areas, including• Victims' rights protections• Public safety and criminal justice reform• Government transparency and accountability• Occupational licensing reform• Corrections oversight• Protecting our pets from animal cruelty• Support for veterans and vulnerable populationsThese legislative accomplishments, achieved during divided government, included strengthening protections for crime victims, improving access to police reports, enhancing oversight and transparency within our corrections system, expanding opportunities through occupational licensing reform, protecting veterans from fraud, improving election administration procedures, increasing accountability in government, and advancing policies that support families, children, and vulnerable adults throughout our state.Together, these efforts resulted in 37 bills signed into law, one ballot proposition approved by Arizona voters in 2024 guaranteeing a life sentence for persons who are found guilty of sex trafficking of a minor child, several one-time budget appropriations, and one concurrent resolution transmitted to the Secretary of State.Of course, not every bill crossed the finish line. Some were vetoed. That's the nature of governing and fighting for what you believe in.One lesson I have learned during my years of public service is that meaningful change rarely happens overnight. Every law signed, every reform enacted, and every problem solved represents countless hours of work, issue advocacy, difficult conversations, and perseverance.Behind every legislative victory is a story. It is the victim who received additional protections. The veteran who gained stronger safeguards. The family that benefited from lower costs. The child who gained greater opportunities. The taxpayer who received greater transparency and accountability from government. Those victories matter regardless of who wins or loses an election.Looking back on the last three years, I am especially proud that many of these accomplishments were achieved in divided government. That required collaboration, compromise when appropriate, and a willingness to build coalitions around ideas that benefited Arizona families.None of these achievements would have been possible without your support. Every conversation, every volunteer hour, every donation, and every vote helped turn ideas into action and made these successes possible.I have been absolutely blessed to work with so many professional policy advisors at the State Senate who tirelessly worked for the people of Arizona. I have also had the pleasure of working with one of the finest political consultants in this state.**THANK YOU. You know who you are.** Your counsel, hard work, friendship, and commitment helped make these victories possible for Legislative District 2 and for our entire state.While I may no longer be actively campaigning, I am certainly not stepping away from the issues that matter most. Arizona remains one of the greatest states in our nation, but preserving our freedoms and opportunities requires informed, engaged citizens who are willing to stay involved.The challenges facing our communities did not disappear on Election Day, and neither did the need for principled leadership and civic participation. The future of Arizona will be shaped by those who remain committed long after campaign signs come down and election advertisements stop running.The election results mark the end of this campaign, but they do not mark the end of our mission.The momentum we created, the relationships we built, and the values we championed together will continue to guide our work in the future.Thank you for standing with me, believing in this effort, and contributing your time, energy, and heart to this campaign. I am deeply grateful for your support, proud of what we accomplished together, and optimistic about what comes next.Once you've recovered from Tuesday's results, I hope you'll remain engaged and continue being a voice for the values that brought us together. Arizona's future will not be determined by one election, one candidate, or one political cycle. It will be shaped by citizens who stay informed, get involved, and remain committed to protecting the freedoms and opportunities that make our state exceptional.Please join me as we continue fighting for lower taxes, educational freedom, public safety, election integrity, economic opportunity, and the constitutional rights that generations of Arizonans have worked hard to preserve.More importantly, [please fill out this form](https://us.list-manage.com/5Otv2PvHgK3?e=a7ab36849c&c2id=b6e4918ecaa4a9e494d38fc9e6fde211) so we can stay connected and continue building a strong network of engaged citizens across our state. These legislative updates and campaign emails may be ending, but our shared commitment to Arizona's future continues.While Tuesday's results were not what we hoped for, they do not define us. We are defined by our character, our convictions, and our willingness to continue serving even when the path forward becomes difficult.I remain optimistic about Arizona's future because I have seen firsthand the passion, generosity, and dedication of the people who call this state home. That gives me confidence that our best days are still ahead.Let's keep moving forward together.With gratitude,Shawnna LM Bolick
P.S. Tuesday's election may be behind us, but the fight for Arizona's future is far from over.My [Substack](https://us.list-manage.com/l8TTG9HFm2l?e=a7ab36849c&c2id=b6e4918ecaa4a9e494d38fc9e6fde211) will be the primary place where I'll continue sharing policy updates, legislative insights, behind-the-scenes perspectives, and opportunities to stay involved.Whether it's defending lower taxes, school choice, public safety, election integrity, or the constitutional freedoms that make Arizona exceptional, I intend to remain engaged and keep you informed.Please subscribe today and join us. The campaign may be over, but our movement is not. Together, we can continue shaping Arizona's future and ensuring that the values we share remain part of the public conversation.Subscribe [here](https://us.list-manage.com/jtkM8cOATMY?e=a7ab36849c&c2id=b6e4918ecaa4a9e494d38fc9e6fde211).

Those victories matter regardless of who wins or loses an election.Looking back on the last three years, I am especially proud that many of these accomplishments were achieved in divided government. That required collaboration, compromise when appropriate, and a willingness to build coalitions around ideas that benefited Arizona families.None of these achievements would have been possible without your support. Every conversation, every volunteer hour, every donation, and every vote helped turn ideas into action and made these successes possible.I have been absolutely blessed to work with so many professional policy advisors at the State Senate who tirelessly worked for the people of Arizona. I have also had the pleasure of working with one of the finest political consultants in this state.THANK YOU. You know who you are. Your counsel, hard work, friendship, and commitment helped make these victories possible for Legislative District 2 and for our entire state.While I may no longer be actively campaigning, I am certainly not stepping away from the issues that matter most. Arizona remains one of the greatest states in our nation, but preserving our freedoms and opportunities requires informed, engaged citizens who are willing to stay involved.The challenges facing our communities did not disappear on Election Day, and neither did the need for principled leadership and civic participation. The future of Arizona will be shaped by those who remain committed long after campaign signs come down and election advertisements stop running.The election results mark the end of this campaign, but they do not mark the end of our mission.The momentum we created, the relationships we built, and the values we championed together will continue to guide our work in the future.Thank you for standing with me, believing in this effort, and contributing your time, energy, and heart to this campaign. I am deeply grateful for your support, proud of what we accomplished together, and optimistic about what comes next.Once you've recovered from Tuesday's results, I hope you'll remain engaged and continue being a voice for the values that brought us together. Arizona's future will not be determined by one election, one candidate, or one political cycle. It will be shaped by citizens who stay informed, get involved, and remain committed to protecting the freedoms and opportunities that make our state exceptional.Please join me as we continue fighting for lower taxes, educational freedom, public safety, election integrity, economic opportunity, and the constitutional rights that generations of Arizonans have worked hard to preserve.More importantly, so we can stay connected and continue building a strong network of engaged citizens across our state. These legislative updates and campaign emails may be ending, but our shared commitment to Arizona's future continues.While Tuesday's results were not what we hoped for, they do not define us. We are defined by our character, our convictions, and our willingness to continue serving even when the path forward becomes difficult.I remain optimistic about Arizona's future because I have seen firsthand the passion, generosity, and dedication of the people who call this state home. That gives me confidence that our best days are still ahead.Let's keep moving forward together.With gratitude,Shawnna LM Bolick P.S. Tuesday's election may be behind us, but the fight for Arizona's future is far from over.My will be the primary place where I'll continue sharing policy updates, legislative insights, behind-the-scenes perspectives, and opportunities to stay involved.Whether it's defending lower taxes, school choice, public safety, election integrity, or the constitutional freedoms that make Arizona exceptional, I intend to remain engaged and keep you informed.Please subscribe today and join us. subject: What do Alaska, Texas, and Kansas have in common?
body:
| | | | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/143031453/658860372/1090555623?refcode=261106_posteday&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MzE2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxZWQ5MDY5Ni0xZWRhLWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDBkM2E1NDQ0MmUiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=St0JiD5zUa9nUK8JF2wlM8qbkKPlaw-ID7dEJnY-2fI=)

| | | I’ve been in politics a long time, and even I was (pleasantly) SHOCKED by Tuesday night’s results.

Before I go any further, THANK YOU: you did this.

Look at what happened on Tuesday for our endorsed Equal Opportunity Now candidates:

In Kansas, Adam Hamilton won a U.S. Senate seat in a state that hadn’t sent a Democrat to the Senate since 1932. Republicans poured millions into stopping a pastor from Kansas. Kansas said no.

In Texas, Gina Hinojosa won the governor’s race, the first Democrat to do it since Ann Richards.

In Alaska, Mary Peltola won her race for the U.S. Senate.

In Arizona’s 1st District, maybe the most contested battleground in the country, Dr. Amish Shah won a seat Republicans had held through seven straight elections.

In Florida, Pia Dandiya is headed to Congress, and Kathy Castor held her seat after Republicans redrew the map to take it from her.

In Alabama, Shomari Figures is going back to Washington to keep fighting for his district.

And across the country, Democrat after Democrat we backed was sent back to Congress to keep up the fight.

Every one of these races is a candidate who Equal Opportunity Now endorsed and supported. These are the fighters we bet on early, when the polls said “longshot,” when the super PACs were lining up against them, and when plenty of people said Kansas and Texas were a waste of time.

We didn’t listen. Neither did you.

None of this happened by accident. It happened because thousands of you chipped in $10 here and $25 there, week after week, while a trillionaire on the other side wrote nine-figure checks. It happened because volunteers knocked doors in Bloomington, Peoria, and towns all over this country. It happened because you refused to sit this one out.

My father used to tell us at the dinner table: “Whatever you do, make sure this country is there for the next families who need it.” When we started Equal Opportunity Now, that’s what this was about. This week, you made it true for a lot of families.

I’m not asking you for anything today. I just want to say thank you. I’m proud of every single one of you.

Take a breath. Celebrate. Then let’s get back to work, because the fights ahead are big, and now we have the people in place to win them.

With gratitude,

— Raja Krishnamoorthi
Founder | Equal Opportunity Now

Yá'át'ééh (Hello) Peter,
Thanks to your incredible grassroots support, I woke up the day after the election to votes still being counted! If we prevail I will make history as the first Native American ever elected to Congress from Arizona.
With this race being neck-and-neck, winning could be determined by “cured” ballots — ballots that have some error or mistake and must be corrected to count. We spent our resources to get this lead, and now I need your help to make sure we can keep it.
**[With this race coming down to these last votes, we are launching an emergency recount fund to make sure we are ready for whatever comes next. Peter, will you split a contribution between Truth to Power and our campaign so they have the funds to make sure every vote is counted?](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21531?c0=em_ms_ttp_20261106_1_ak.Yuy5l6&refcode=em20261106-41642&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=41642%2E3422442%2E-PEZFI)**

In this David versus Goliath fight, _**every** vote counts._
When we first launched this campaign, we weren’t supposed to be competitive. And now, in a deep red seat that Trump won by 15 points, an Indigenous sheepherder from the Navajo Nation is standing on the verge of defeating one of Trump’s favorite members of Congress.
That’s why we need to finish strong and make sure we have the resources to fight back against any Republican attempts to sway this count.
**[In this final push, can I count on you to split a donation between Truth to Power and my emergency recount fund?](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21531?c0=em_ms_ttp_20261106_1_ak.Yuy5l6&refcode=em20261106-41642&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=23&akid=41642%2E3422442%2E-PEZFI)**

Jonathan

Peter,

Look, when I first jumped into the race to beat Cindy Hyde-Smith, the national pundits didn’t really know what to expect. They wrote us off.

My first campaign event had four people.

Now, we’re on the verge of making history and flipping Mississippi’s Senate race. And it’s all thanks to one thing: GRASSROOTS DONORS.

That’s why, all along the walls of my office, I’ve hung photos of people we’ve met on the campaign trail. They remind me to take a little bit of joy in the campaign. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/143032228/658863012/-1962313004?refcode=LOC_EM_FR_2026.11.06_Colom-Split_B1_F1_S1_C1_30DD30DO30DC_N-T0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjIvMS8xMTc5MjMiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNjFkYjM3ZWQtMjJkYS1mMTExLWJmNWItMDAwZDNhNTQ0NDJlIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=SoFCP_OphWOgpgAcwo0YVmLuHgxtSJGlGDlEIEUJavM=) **These photos remind me of why I’m in this race. The people of Mississippi are finally getting the attention they deserve and I am proud to be fighting for the people of Mississippi in this moment.**

But our work is far from over.

We need to make sure that we are able to protect the will of the voters. _If we want to do it right – and we HAVE to do it right – it’s going to cost millions and millions of dollars._

clean_body: Fellow Patriot, We face powerful foes today who are willing to do anything to dominate America, even if it means destroying democracy. The Left's so-called principles are utterly incompatible with those that are the bedrock of our constitutional republic. They're incompatible with individual liberty and free will. They're incompatible with the Judeo-Christian belief system under which this nation was founded. At a time when the very values that make America great are under attack, we must continue to stand strong. We must make sure our fellow citizens understand the seriousness of this situation. I'll never stop defending America, our Constitution, our free market economy, and our Judeo-Christian traditions. And I'll never stop calling out the leftists who want to tear our country down. I know you won't either! I do a lot of things. But one of the most important things I do is work with my colleagues at Landmark Legal Foundation. Landmark Legal Foundation is on a mission. They 're here to protect liberty, property rights, constitutionalism . . . in other words, what you read in the Declaration of Independence and the Constitution. And now, I'd love you to stand with me in supporting this outstanding organization. The Left aren't saviors of democracy.They 're Marxists. And what they're doing is destroying the country. They fight desperately to undermine our election processes and, if elections go against them, they use the courts to obstruct the policies We the People voted for. They persecute their opponents, like when the Biden In justice Department waged relentless lawfare against Trump and his allies. Leftists focus so much energy on the justice system - to control it, to contort it, to use it to promote their insanely radical agenda. Again and again, they turn to rogue left-wing judges to usurp the Constitution and undermine America's founding principles. We must not be silent while these leftists destroy our republic from within. That 's why it's so great to have Landmark Legal Foundation take them on! I love these guys. I've been part of the Landmark family for over three decades . . . as president for 20 years, then Chairman of the Board, and now Chairman Emeritus. These briefs present the strongest possible argument for the constitutional position and help convince judges to do the right thing. In 2024, Landmark made a historic winning argument that special prosecutor Jack Smith lacked the legal authority to target Donald Trump in the classified documents probe. The judge in the case echoed Landmark's arguments in her decision and delivered a huge win over the Left 's lawfare. Landmark also fights to defend free, fair elections. For example, Landmark filed a supportive brief in another key election integrity case. With Bost v. Illinois Board of Elections , they're helping challenge unfair vote-by-mail procedures. Here, Illinois Congressman Mike Bost sued the Illinois Board of Elections over their practice of counting mail-in ballots received after Election Day. Such counting delays results and opens the door for abuse. When the Supreme Court agreed, it marked a major victory for free, fair elections. But this is not the last fight! This isn't political . . . it 's about the Constitution! My Landmark friends are on the frontlines of the battle to preserve our country. They're a vital part of the conservative, constitutionalist force fighting for our country today. Your support will help Landmark Legal Foundation live up to its motto of " Defending Liberty, Fighting Tyranny." Thank you in advance for actively joining the fight! God Bless, Mark Levin Chairman Emeritus Landmark Legal Foundation Landmark Legal Foundation is a 501(c)(3) Not For Profit Organization. All donations are tax-deductible.

body:

| | | | | | Hello Friends,
Thank you! Despite this being the worst election for Republicans in my lifetime, **we were able to win by 5.3%**. Thank you to all of the financial donors and to those who helped with doors, postcards, letters, putting up signs, working on election day and so much more! I could not have done this without you!
The Democrat top of the ticket won our State House district by almost 19% points. Which means that **we outperformed the top of the ticket by ~24%** (-19% for Garrity to +5% for Shaffer). Our area also had some of the highest turnout precincts in Allegheny County. Our positive, results oriented campaign helped to drive out voters and win over an enormous number of ticket splitters.
I will continue to work tirelessly in my second term to make our state and area even better! I will work across party lines and strive to bring people together. In a time when politics seems so polarized and divisive I know we can and must do better. However, I will also not hesitate to take principled stands when bad policies threaten our prosperity and freedoms.

I appreciate your trust and will not let you down. Thank you!

_**Election Night with the family (minus Sarah Anne at Univ of Kentucky)
**_
_**A View of the Party**_ _****_

Sincerely,

| | | For years, folks in Washington wrote off the South as “deep red” territory and spent their money somewhere else. We refused to accept that as fact.

On campus. In 5,000+ student chapters. Training young leaders. And carrying Charlie's mission forward.

Patriot, _Right Wing Revolution_ is the battle plan Charlie left for this moment.

It's not an ordinary political book...

It's a roadmap for winning back our culture and the hearts and minds of young Americans.

**Inside, Charlie lays out a vision for an America where: ** ✅ Faith and patriotism are celebrated, not silenced
✅ Our borders are secure and our Constitution is respected
✅ We trust our neighbors and feel safe in our communities
✅ The next generation grows up God-fearing and loving this country

That's the America Charlie fought for. That's the mission Turning Point USA carries forward.

I was born and raised in Mississippi. Growing up here, I never thought I would be locked in what is shaping up to be the closest Senate race in modern history.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/143034496/658870389/-1453808040?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&amount=5&refcode=email_bu_gmailnd_jtk7000&refcode2=1a630a51-2bda-f111-bf5b-000d3a54442e&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxYTYzMGE1MS0yYmRhLWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDBkM2E1NDQ0MmUiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=PaQb60HHGY03yLWfp3tTdghoaZIaxAPaGuVJsrr7O7Y=)

But this race isn’t over yet.

We need to make sure that we stand up for the will of the voters from now until this is fully certified. In a state like Mississippi, we can’t afford to get complacent at the finish line.

Closing this race out is going to cost millions of dollars. This is going to be the most closely divided U.S. Senate race in modern American history.

The state Republican lawmakers who survived the brutal blue-wave elections this week convened in Augusta on Friday to select caucus leaders.
The 11-member Senate Republican caucus, which has shrunk by three seats from the last session, stuck with last cycle's Senate Minority Leader Sen. Trey Stewart of Aroostook as caucus leader. The group tapped Sen. David Haggan of Penobscot as Assistant Minority Leader or whip.
As with the Senate, Republicans on the House side experienced some shrinkage.
The caucus held 73 seats in the 132nd Legislature. It will have 61 in the 133rd, a net loss of 12, bringing the GOP perilously close to super-minority territory at the State House that would allow Democratic lawmakers to run amendments to the state constitution.
[Share The Robinson Report](https://substack.com/redirect/ff5cb900-0e51-47d8-9335-f131c922bc43?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The caucus chose as its Minority Leader Ken Fredette of Newport, while his Assistant Leader will be Alicia Collins of Sidney.
Of all the leadership picks, the most consequential will be Fredette. In the last session, he was the top Republican on the critical Appropriations Committee, where many of the most consequential decisions are made -- sometimes in secret and in the dark of night.
The Newport lawyer brings more political experience to the table than all of the other leaders combined.
He worked on Bob Dole's 1988 presidential campaign, served as field director for Gov. Jock McKernan's 1990 re-election, and then as political director for former Republican State Sen. Rick Bennett's 1994 congressional campaign. He was an alternate delegate to Republican National Conventions in 1996 and 2008.
Fredette was first elected to the Maine House himself in 2010 as part of the same Tea Party wave that swept Gov. Paul LePage into his first term in the Blaine House. After the 2012 elections, he was chosen House Republican Minority Leader, a post he held through 2018.
That experience will be necessary for Republicans in the 133rd Legislature to forestall the most egregious progressive policies that an emboldened and radicalized Democratic Party will put forward.

House Democrats are sticking with Speaker Ryan Fecteau of Biddeford and Majority Leader Matt Moonen of Portland, and Rep. Ambureen Rana of Bangor will be the new assistant majority leader.
Senate Democrats are expected to reappoint Sen. Mattie Daughtry of Brunswick as Senate President.
Daughtry, a brewery owner who had the good fortune to secure $500k in state taxpayer dollars from the Finance Authority of Maine for her three-person beer company during COVID-19, is chiefly known for imposing the one-percent paycheck tax that funds the paid vacation law which started earlier this year.

With 24 senators, Democrats have the two-thirds needed to pass emergency bills in the Senate without a single Republican vote.
In the House, 90 votes leave them short of two-thirds, so Fredette's 61 members can still block a few things: emergency measures, bond questions and constitutional amendments. But only if they hang together and show up regularly.
If legislative Democrats catch Republicans on a day with poor attendance, they could easily take advantage of the numbers game to impose radical changes the GOP might otherwise have blocked.
The 133rd Legislature convenes Dec. 2, when leadership votes become formal.

clean_body: Fellow Patriot, We face powerful foes today who are willing to do anything to dominate America, even if it means destroying democracy. The Left's so-called principles are utterly incompatible with those that are the bedrock of our constitutional republic. They're incompatible with individual liberty and free will. They're incompatible with the Judeo-Christian belief system under which this nation was founded. At a time when the very values that make America great are under attack, we must continue to stand strong. We must make sure our fellow citizens understand the seriousness of this situation. I'll never stop defending America, our Constitution, our free market economy, and our Judeo-Christian traditions. And I'll never stop calling out the leftiCFD who want to tear our country down. I know you won't either! I do a lot of things. But one of the most important things I do is work with my colleagues at Landmark Legal Foundation. Landmark Legal Foundation is on a mission. They 're here to protect liberty, property rights, constitutionalism . . . in other words, what you read in the Declaration of Independence and the Constitution. And now, I'd love you to stand with me in supporting this outstanding organization. The Left aren't saviors of democracy.They 're MarxiCFD. And what they're doing is destroying the country. They fight desperately to undermine our election processes and, if elections go against them, they use the courts to obstruct the policies We the People voted for. They persecute their opponents, like when the Biden In justice Department waged relentless lawfare against Trump and his allies. LeftiCFD focus so much energy on the justice system - to control it, to contort it, to use it to promote their insanely radical agenda. Again and again, they turn to rogue left-wing judges to usurp the Constitution and undermine America's founding principles. We must not be silent while these leftiCFD destroy our republic from within. That 's why it's so great to have Landmark Legal Foundation take them on! I love these guys. I've been part of the Landmark family for over three decades . . . as president for 20 years, then Chairman of the Board, and now Chairman Emeritus. These briefs present the strongest possible argument for the constitutional position and help convince judges to do the right thing. In 2024, Landmark made a historic winning argument that special prosecutor Jack Smith lacked the legal authority to target Donald Trump in the classified documents probe. The judge in the case echoed Landmark's arguments in her decision and delivered a huge win over the Left 's lawfare. Landmark also fights to defend free, fair elections. For example, Landmark filed a supportive brief in another key election integrity case. With Bost v. Illinois Board of Elections , they're helping challenge unfair vote-by-mail procedures. Here, Illinois Congressman Mike Bost sued the Illinois Board of Elections over their practice of counting mail-in ballots received after Election Day. Such counting delays results and opens the door for abuse. When the Supreme Court agreed, it marked a major victory for free, fair elections. But this is not the last fight! This isn't political . . . it 's about the Constitution! My Landmark friends are on the frontlines of the battle to preserve our country. They're a vital part of the conservative, constitutionalist force fighting for our country today. Your support will help Landmark Legal Foundation live up to its motto of " Defending Liberty, Fighting Tyranny." Thank you in advance for actively joining the fight! God Bless, Mark Levin Chairman Emeritus Landmark Legal Foundation Landmark Legal Foundation is a 501(c)(3) Not For Profit Organization. All donations are tax-deductible.

---
We did it, friend.
On Tuesday, the American people sent a powerful message to Donald Trump and his Republican allies that it’s not about the people in power. It’s about the power that’s in the people.
And the _people_ have delivered resounding, historic victories for Democrats across the South and throughout the country. That includes right here in Georgia, where we reelected Sen. Jon Ossoff and elected the first Black woman governor in U.S. history, Keisha Lance Bottoms.
Now, we finally put some guardrails on this President. Now, we finally bring accountability for the harm and the chaos and the corruption. Now, a better future begins.
With brand-new Democratic majorities in both the House and the Senate, I’m fired up to get to work on the issues you care about most – the issues that will really make a difference for you and your family.
**I wish more than anything I could sit down with each and every member of this team over a cup of coffee today to hear about your biggest hopes for these brighter days ahead. But sharing your thoughts with me directly in this new priorities survey is the next best thing.**
**[Will you take a few moments now to share your top priorities for this new Congress? name: Drew For Nevada
subject: The Election Is Over. The Work Isn't.
body:
I'm proud of what we accomplished, grateful for your support, and not giving up on Nevada.

| | | | | | |
#### [DrewForNevada.com](https://us.list-manage.com/cNloNb_GFfM?e=817ed65ac7&c2id=d5ba536a36ebcb17f684b24f2e31274d)
---
| | | | | | | | | | | | | | | [](https://us.list-manage.com/prDY5Q8eYI4?e=817ed65ac7&c2id=d5ba536a36ebcb17f684b24f2e31274d)
---
[](https://us.list-manage.com/1S3GBNoH7BO?e=817ed65ac7&c2id=d5ba536a36ebcb17f684b24f2e31274d)
---
[](https://us.list-manage.com/tvG9Z68Kvkq?e=817ed65ac7&c2id=d5ba536a36ebcb17f684b24f2e31274d)
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/msxoR9j6YhJ?e=817ed65ac7&c2id=d5ba536a36ebcb17f684b24f2e31274d)
| | | | | |
Peter -
As you likely know, we came up short in our race for Nevada State Treasurer.
There’s no way around it: this was a brutal election for Republicans in Nevada. The national political winds were simply too strong to overcome.
**But I am incredibly proud of the race we ran.**
Over the past year, I traveled across Nevada, met thousands of people, listened to their concerns, and talked about real solutions — saving the Millennium Scholarship, improving Nevada’s credit rating, cutting taxes, protecting taxpayer dollars, and making state government more accountable.
We didn’t run a campaign built around slogans or platitudes. We ran on ideas.
And it worked. **We were the best-performing non-incumbent Republican in Nevada.**
I’m proud of that. But it doesn’t make losing any easier.
And I worry that the Nevada so many of us love — independent, low-tax, entrepreneurial, skeptical of government, and fiercely protective of individual freedom — is being pulled in a very different direction.
But I also know this: **this is not the end of the story.**
What happened on Election Day wasn’t a rejection of the principles we believe in. If anything, it was the result of what happens when people who claim to represent those principles abandon them.
There is no way I can adequately thank the people who stood with me through all of this.
My experience as a candidate has produced more than its share of heartbreak.
I ran a race for Clark County Commission that virtually everyone considered unwinnable — and won by thousands of votes on Election Day. I then watched that lead disappear nearly a week later as late-arriving mail ballots continued to be counted.
Two years later, I became the best-performing Republican congressional challenger in the entire country — and still fell just short.
And now, I’ve lost a race we would have won in a normal political year, only to get caught in a nationwide “Blue-nami.”
As painful as those losses have been, I would still do it all again.
I would do it because of the people I met, the support I felt, and the friendships I made.
Throughout my career, I’ve worked to advance liberty and limited government, expose waste and corruption, protect taxpayers, and challenge politicians and bureaucrats when they forget who they work for.
I ran for office because I wanted the opportunity to do that work from inside government. That didn’t happen, but the work continues.
I’ll continue serving as a Senior Scholar at the [**National Center for Public Policy Research**](https://us.list-manage.com/FbwzKPSa51Y?e=817ed65ac7&c2id=d5ba536a36ebcb17f684b24f2e31274d) and the [**Center for Healthcare Affordability**](https://us.list-manage.com/16SgTMDV7xc?e=817ed65ac7&c2id=d5ba536a36ebcb17f684b24f2e31274d). I’ll keep writing for [**Newsmax**](https://us.list-manage.com/NrEihf05wtY?e=817ed65ac7&c2id=d5ba536a36ebcb17f684b24f2e31274d) and [**Townhall**](https://us.list-manage.com/dEb1hfUGg0o?e=817ed65ac7&c2id=d5ba536a36ebcb17f684b24f2e31274d). And I’ll keep fighting bad policy and wasteful government, and exposing corrupt politicians.
I’m not giving up.
I hope you won’t either.
**Most importantly, I want to thank my incredible wife, Sarah.** There is simply no way I could have done any of this without her.
The sacrifices she has made for our campaigns — personally, professionally, and financially — have been enormous.
Anyone who knows Sarah knows that she has never needed me, or any political campaign, to give her a cause worth fighting for. Because of Sarah’s work, boys and men are no longer allowed to compete in girls’ high school sports in Nevada.
She took on that fight when doing so was difficult and professionally risky. She knew there could be consequences, but she believed it was right. And it cost her the career she had spent years building.
She never complained or asked for sympathy. She was simply proud that, when it mattered, she stood up for something she believed in.
And that's just one example of the difference she's made in Nevada. Sarah also helped get three pieces of legislation passed that removed barriers and created opportunities for small business owners. Because of her work, Nevadans have been able to turn their passions into livelihoods, create jobs, and better provide for their families.
She doesn't do it for recognition or political gain. She does it because she genuinely wants to make life better for Nevadans.
That says a lot about who she is. I am truly blessed to go through life with her beside me.
**I also want to thank my team, Robert Uithoven, Raymond Serrano, and Sherman Tylawski** for their wisdom and tireless dedication to our campaign.
Finally, I want to **thank every person who helped us along the way** — the people who opened their homes and hosted events, the volunteers who wrote postcards until their hands hurt, the people who knocked on doors in 110-degree Nevada heat, and everyone who made calls, sent texts, put up signs, talked to neighbors, shared our message, prayed for us, and donated their hard-earned money because they believed in what we were trying to accomplish.
**I never took any of that support for granted. And I will never forget it.**
We have a fight on our hands to preserve what makes Nevada special, to stop our state from becoming something we no longer recognize, and to make sure liberty, opportunity, and limited government still have a future here.
I’ll be standing beside you in the fight ahead every step of the way.

Peter,

Because of you, I have the honor of continuing to represent Washington's 8th District in Congress—a responsibility and a privilege I will never take lightly or for granted.

Tuesday night, we saw unprecedented victories across the country. It's clear there is a yearning for real, ethical leadership that will put the American people first and serve as a check on this dangerous and disastrous administration. I have never been more ready and fired up to go to D.C. and deliver for you.

Our country is in a pivotal moment. While I'll always work with anyone on policies that help you, I will also always stand up to anyone who makes life harder for you. We need to address skyrocketing costs and take on big business monopolies that abuse their power. We need to reform our healthcare system. We need to protect our children from Big Tech and put serious guardrails on AI development. I'm ready to do all of this and more.

To every single person who put their faith in me: **You are the heart of this campaign, and the reason I have the incredible privilege of continuing to serve our community in Congress.** I truly hope you know just how much you all mean to me, and to this campaign.

I promise to keep listening, showing up, and fighting for the families who call our district home. There is still so much work to do, and I'm deeply grateful you've given me the opportunity to keep doing it—with a lot of fantastic new friends!

From the bottom of my heart, _thank you, and keep the faith._

While I'll always work with anyone on policies that help you, I will also always stand up to anyone who makes life harder for you. We need to address skyrocketing costs and take on big business monopolies that abuse their power. We need to reform our healthcare system. We need to protect our children from Big Tech and put serious guardrails on AI development. I'm ready to do all of this and more. To every single person who put their faith in me: You are the heart of this campaign, and the reason I have the incredible privilege of continuing to serve our community in Congress. I truly hope you know just how much you all mean to me, and to this campaign. I promise to keep listening, showing up, and fighting for the families who call our district home. There is still so much work to do, and I'm deeply grateful you've given me the opportunity to keep doing it—with a lot of fantastic new friends! From the bottom of my heart, thank you, and keep the faith. Kim Rep. Kim Schrier is a doctor, scientist, and mom, fighting for Washington's 8th District in Congress. This is one of the most competitive districts in the country, so we need your help to keep Kim in Congress. * * *
Hey folks,
Trump just put Stephen Miller in charge of the White House, and apparently Republicans learned absolutely nothing from getting their asses kicked on Tuesday.
[Jack Cocchiarella](https://open.substack.com/users/112946688-jack-cocchiarella?utm_source=mentions) and I break down this insane decision, what it means for immigrant communities, and why Democrats have a once-in-a-generation opportunity to fight back. We got heated. We got personal. And we talked about what it actually takes to turn a historic election victory into lasting change.
Here's what we covered:
* [**00:01:33**] The breaking news of Stephen Miller replacing Susie Wiles, why this is so dangerous, and what Trump's decision tells us about a Republican Party that refuses to learn.
* [**00:05:11**] Miller's reported plan to govern without Congress, the threat of executive overreach, and why Democrats need to prepare for a serious fight.
* [**00:08:48**] How Trump's immigration crackdown distracts from the real affordability crisis, corruption, and the billionaires getting richer while working families struggle.
* [**00:12:14**] Why I'm sick of Democrats being told not to overreach after a historic victory, and why accountability cannot be confused with political revenge.
* [**00:16:16**] The path forward: investigations, healthcare subsidies, sweeping ethics reform, and how Democrats can use this moment to build an even bigger majority in 2028.

Here's the bottom line: The American people didn't hand Democrats a historic victory so we could write strongly worded letters and play nice with people who have abused their power. They want results. They want accountability. They want a government that actually makes their lives better. Jack and I get into all of it, including why corruption is an affordability issue, why we need to elevate a new generation of Democratic leaders, and why we cannot waste this moment. **If you believe independent voices willing to have these conversations matter, help me keep this work going.**

Tomorrow, we take off. Here’s how to make sure The Virginia Flyover lands in your inbox.

| | |
---
You're officially part of **The Virginia Flyover Crew**. Welcome aboard! ✈️ We're glad you're here. Starting tomorrow, you can expect _**The Virginia Flyover**_ in your inbox each morning--a quick, engaging rundown of the Virginia stories worth knowing, along with the biggest national headlines impacting the Commonwealth. It's designed to give you the important stuff without taking up your whole morning. And yes, **it 's free.** Want to see what you signed up for? [You can read our latest Virginia edition here.](https://email.editor.thevirginiaflyover.com/c/eJxsz79ugzAQgPGnsbeg82H8Z_DQhS1dOyKDz3CSCZFxqfr2VTNn__STvq_7dI9c-LF-xp1Cu_L0fVKdENDclLqBkSnkqCl6SUFZrwHQ6V5uwVqH2fVJLQbM7H2aHQ2qN2TcMg9gJId_RSkwiGARuhwpAWQij7hEHIQGStyO2rWNLq4rPzjm8ntcVLvl2GUJW2vPU_QfAkeB4_tM4Fhio7MJHGUN6fnDpfBprNCw7pHLy2pv566AfwEAAP__5LlQ6A) Before we send you on your way, we have one small favor to ask.
### Help us make sure _The Virginia Flyover_ actually lands in your inbox
Email providers sometimes have a mind of their own, especially when you've just subscribed to something new. Taking a minute to tell your inbox you _want_ to hear from us can help make sure tomorrow's Virginia Flyover doesn't get lost along the way. **The easiest thing you can do?** Hit reply to this email and let us know you got it. Even a quick "Got it!" will do. Then, depending on which email service you use, here's one more step you can take: **Gmail**
* **On your phone:** Tap the three dots (...) in the top-right corner, choose "Move to," then select "Primary." If you don't see Primary as an option, you're already set.
* **On desktop:** Go back to your inbox and drag this email into the "Primary" tab.

**Apple Mail**
* Tap our email address at the top of this email (next to "From:" on mobile), then select "Add to VIP."

**AOL Mail**
* Select "Contacts," then "New Contact." Add [news@editor.thevirginiaflyover.com](mailto:news@editor.thevirginiaflyover.com) and save it as a contact.

**Outlook**
* Hover over our email address at the top of this email, click the three dots, choose "Add to Outlook Contacts," then click "Save" or "Create."

**Use something else?** [You can find instructions for your email provider here.](https://email.editor.thevirginiaflyover.com/c/eJxsz7FuwyAQgOGngc3WcSbYDAxdvKVrR4vCgU_CdoSJo7591c7Zf33S_3Vf7p4L7_nTb-TalZbnSXVBQNMp1YGR0SWvyVtJTo1WA-CkB7k6xGBCUgbDbQpgjY2jNipMalAaxm-Q7P4UpcAgwojQJ08RIBFZxODxJjRQ5HbUvq10cc28s0_l57io9uHYZHFra49TDB8CZ4Hz-0zg_Fq5UeGz8Z67_ORIAmdZXXy8uBQ-zSg05M1z-Xfb29HL4W8AAAD__7CEVTg) And that's it. You're ready for takeoff. One last thing: **we really do want to hear from you.** If you have feedback, a Virginia story you think we should cover, or just want to tell us what you think of _The Virginia Flyover_ , email our Editor anytime at **[editor@thevirginiaflyover.com](mailto:editor@jointheflyover.com?subject=Feedback%20for%20The%20Virginia%20Flyover)**. Thanks for joining us. We'll see you in your inbox!

Welcome aboard! ✈️ We're glad you're here. Starting tomorrow, you can expect The Virginia Flyover in your inbox each morning--a quick, engaging rundown of the Virginia stories worth knowing, along with the biggest national headlines impacting the Commonwealth. It's designed to give you the important stuff without taking up your whole morning. And yes, it 's free. Want to see what you signed up for? Before we send you on your way, we have one small favor to ask. Help us make sure The Virginia Flyover actually lands in your inbox Email providers sometimes have a mind of their own, especially when you've just subscribed to something new. Taking a minute to tell your inbox you want to hear from us can help make sure tomorrow's Virginia Flyover doesn't get lost along the way. The easiest thing you can do? Hit reply to this email and let us know you got it. Even a quick "Got it!" will do. Then, depending on which email service you use, here's one more step you can take: Gmail On your phone: Tap the three dots (...) in the top-right corner, choose "Move to," then select "Primary." If you don't see Primary as an option, you're already set. On desktop: Go back to your inbox and drag this email into the "Primary" tab. Apple Mail Tap our email address at the top of this email (next to "From:" on mobile), then select "Add to VIP." AOL Mail Select "Contacts," then "New Contact." Add mailto:news@editor.thevirginiaflyover.com and save it as a contact. Outlook Hover over our email address at the top of this email, click the three dots, choose "Add to Outlook Contacts," then click "Save" or "Create." Use something else? And that's it. You're ready for takeoff. One last thing: we really do want to hear from you. If you have feedback, a Virginia story you think we should cover, or just want to tell us what you think of The Virginia Flyover , email our Editor anytime at mailto:editor@jointheflyover.com?subject=Feedback%20for%20The%20Virginia%20Flyover**. Bobby Scott, Jennifer McClellan, Eugene Vindman, Don Beyer, James Walkinshaw, and Suhas Subramanyam are strong advocates for their districts, and I’m looking forward to continuing to serve alongside them in Congress.

Not only did we reelect every single House Democratic incumbent, we scored two critical battleground wins in districts that paved the way for the new Democratic House majority.

**These important House wins are, in part, because this grassroots team chipped in time and time again, supporting their campaigns and the infrastructure to help support all Virginia Democrats on the ballot this year. So, thank you. This win is yours as well.**

I’m excited to get to work with our newly expanded Virginia Democratic Congressional delegation – and continue to fight for working families in Washington.

Thank you for everything. The fight continues,

Mark Warner

name: Gretchen Whitmer
subject: Tuesday was a B-F-D

body:
I'm feeling pretty damn good about what we accomplished together. |
#
---
Team, I've had a few days to take in Tuesday's election results, and I have to tell you, I'm feeling pretty damn good about what we accomplished together. Here in Michigan, we made history. For the first time in more than 60 years, voters elected back-to-back governors from the same party, sending Jocelyn Benson to the governor's office and delivering another Democratic trifecta in Lansing. Across the country, Democrats flipped both the House and Senate, keeping Michigan blue and winning Senate seats in Texas and Kansas for the first time in decades. We also flipped three competitive congressional districts right here in Michigan. And we made history in governors' races across the country. **Keisha Lance Bottoms became the first Black woman elected governor in American history. Deb Haaland will be our nation's first Native American woman governor. Gina Hinojosa became the first Latina elected governor of Texas, and Amy Acton became the first woman elected governor of Ohio. We also elected the first Black governors in Nevada and Wisconsin with Aaron Ford and David Crowley.** As a woman who's had the honor of serving as governor, I can't tell you how much it means to see so many new barriers broken and doors opened for the next generation. We're still watching the results come in, including some incredibly close Senate races in Alaska and Mississippi. But one thing is already clear. Americans want leaders who are focused on lowering costs, protecting their freedoms, and making their lives better. **Most importantly, I want to thank the millions of Americans who made their voices heard on Tuesday.** Every voter who showed up, every volunteer who knocked on doors, and every person who helped their friends and neighbors get to the polls made a difference. And to this Fight Like Hell team, I owe you a special thank you. You've stood with us through a long, intense election, supported our work across the country, and graciously tolerated a truly impressive number of emails we've sent your way. Believe me when I say that I'm enormously grateful for your support. There's a lot to celebrate, and even more work ahead. But for now, I hope you take a moment to enjoy this victory. You've certainly earned it. clean_body: I'm feeling pretty damn good about what we accomplished together. | Team, I've had a few days to take in Tuesday's election results, and I have to tell you, I'm feeling pretty damn good about what we accomplished together. Here in Michigan, we made history. For the first time in more than 60 years, voters elected back-to-back governors from the same party, sending Jocelyn Benson to the governor's office and delivering another Democratic trifecta in Lansing. Across the country, Democrats flipped both the House and Senate, keeping Michigan blue and winning Senate seats in Texas and Kansas for the first time in decades. We also flipped three competitive congressional districts right here in Michigan. And we made history in governors' races across the country. Keisha Lance Bottoms became the first Black woman elected governor in American history. Deb Haaland will be our nation's first Native American woman governor. Gina Hinojosa became the first Latina elected governor of Texas, and Amy Acton became the first woman elected governor of Ohio. We also elected the first Black governors in Nevada and Wisconsin with Aaron Ford and David Crowley. As a woman who's had the honor of serving as governor, I can't tell you how much it means to see so many new barriers broken and doors opened for the next generation. We're still watching the results come in, including some incredibly close Senate races in Alaska and Mississippi. But one thing is already clear. Americans want leaders who are focused on lowering costs, protecting their freedoms, and making their lives better. Most importantly, I want to thank the millions of Americans who made their voices heard on Tuesday. Every voter who showed up, every volunteer who knocked on doors, and every person who helped their friends and neighbors get to the polls made a difference. And to this Fight Like Hell team, I owe you a special thank you. You've stood with us through a long, intense election, supported our work across the country, and graciously tolerated a truly impressive number of emails we've sent your way. Believe me when I say that I'm enormously grateful for your support. There's a lot to celebrate, and even more work ahead. But for now, I hope you take a moment to enjoy this victory. You've certainly earned it. Thank you for fighting like hell, Gretchen Whitmer | | = Fight Like Hell PAC PO BOX 15093 Lansing, MI 48901 United States ** | mailto:info@fightlikehellpac.org| | Paid for by Fight Like Hell PAC. The 2026 midterms are in the rearview, Democrats swept, but instead of celebrating they are plotting their next power move.
You'd think they'd be satisfied with wins in Texas and Mississippi, but If anything, the inflammatory rhetoric targeting Republicans and right-leaning figures is circulating across social media with renewed intensity.
It brings us to a question we shouldn't have to ask, but do: Are threats against political opponents becoming normalized? Is the Democrat movement an inherently violent one?
Let's start with the rhetoric. Anti-communist activist **[Drew Pavlou](https://substack.com/redirect/b15c3810-2429-4f4c-936a-6a51c0e9cfea?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** recently highlighted a viral Instagram post that stated plain as day what Democrats want:
"If Elon Musk is alive at Christmas, it has been a failure."
[| | | | | Drew Pavlou 🇦🇺🇺🇸🇫🇷🇺🇦🇹🇼
---
@DrewPavlou
Left wing influencer followed by Abdul El-Sayed calls for mass executions of Republicans. ''If Elon Musk is alive at Christmas, it has been a failure.'' 26,000 likes and counting on Instagram
| 1:11 AM * Nov 5, 2026 * 867K Views1.32K Replies * 3.5K Reposts * 13.8K Likes
---](https://substack.com/redirect/66ef7096-a7ed-49c2-83f8-771ec649c9aa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The post reportedly racked up over 26,000 likes. The message alone is terrifying, but the outpouring of support is why I think this isn't simply an isolated madmen in a sea of reasonable liberals. Republicans must be on their guard in the coming months, as we've only seen an increase in political assassinations over the past 3 years.

# **We 're not giving up this fight, and neither should you**
Tuesday was a wake up call to all American patriots...

Just last month authorities investigated a woman named Allison Albro after a social media post allegedly threatened violence involving a Glock at a Trump rally. When deputies and the Secret Service showed up at her door, **[captured on body-camera footage](https://substack.com/redirect/1dafca61-ec6d-4e53-8309-24fc76ab57bf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** , she immediately claimed the post was just a "joke." The suspect had acquired a weapon and was being monitored before authorities intervened, potentially preventing an attack at a community chili cook-off where Self was scheduled to appear. Indiana also got a third Democratic congressman for the first time since the 2010 election. Congratulations to Congressman-elect J.D. Ford in Indiana’s 5th District. He’s the first Democrat to represent that district in over 30 years. This is a huge, momentous win for Indiana, and signals that Hoosiers are ready for a change in leadership. An incredible thank you to every member of this team, every donor, every volunteer, and every voter who made this possible! ****

subject: He survived 9/11. Now he may die in prison.
body:
My brother defended himself... now he’s charged with murder

View in Web Browser
[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e17116491/UaHR0cHM6Ly93cm8ubnVjbGV1c2VtYWlsLmNvbS9hbXBsaWZ5L3YvSnh4R1ZlTnE3QQ/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNjExMDY/LbmNsNFpMU1JOMA/qP2hpZHM9bmNFbThTN1h5aW1lalBsc10/gau5hAw/s8v10a9585f

Dear Fellow Patriot,
[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.

Never in a million years did I think I would be writing an email like
this.

BUT THE TRUTH IS, MY FAMILY AND I ARE OUT OF OPTIONS. AND YOU'RE OUR
ONLY HOPE.
[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.

[Image showing officer, police officer, and captain]
[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.

This is a photo of my brother, Anthony DeLustro.

Anthony spent more than 20 years serving citizens as an NYPD cop,
hunting down dangerous drug dealers and busting up drug dens.

On 9/11, he helped evacuate hundreds of people from one of the
buildings just before it collapsed. Since that day, he's been battling
cancer and Ground Zero Lung from the toxic fumes.

We really thought Anthony had been through the worst of it.

THEN HE TOOK A POLICE JOB IN A SMALL SOUTH CAROLINA TOWN SO HE COULD
SPEND HIS GOLDEN YEARS CLOSE TO HIS GRANDKIDS.

How could I have known he was about to face the greatest danger of his
life?

I'm not talking about a drug dealer or a terrorist or even cancer...

...BUT A LOCAL PROSECUTOR HELLBENT ON DESTROYING MY BROTHER FOR
DEFENDING HIMSELF WHEN HE WAS THE VICTIM OF A ROAD RAGE INCIDENT.

Let me explain.

The day Anthony was attacked, he was off duty. He and his wife had
stopped for lunch after spending the morning at a "Coffee With A Cop"
community event.

As they tried to pull out of the crowded restaurant parking lot,
another driver jumped out of his car and began screaming threats at my
brother.

ANTHONY TRIED TO CALM HIM DOWN.

BUT THE MAN ATTACKED HIM, STRIKING HIM OVER AND OVER.

Anthony pulled out his badge and told the man he was under arrest.

Instead of complying, the man knocked the badge out of Anthony's hand,
got in his car, and tried to flee...

...dragging my brother with his vehicle and running over his legs.

In that moment, Anthony knew he was about to be crushed to death in
front of his own wife.

So he fired a single shot into his attacker's arm, bringing the car to
a stop.

Anthony's quick thinking saved his life.

But the road rage driver who attacked him died at the scene.

When I got the call that Anthony had been assaulted and was in the
hospital with serious injuries, I was so relieved he was alive.

BUT MY RELIEF TURNED INTO SHOCK WHEN MY BROTHER WAS ARRESTED AND
CHARGED WITH MURDER.

He hadn't even recovered from his injuries when the local prosecutor
dragged him in front of a judge and had him locked up in jail.

And now he's facing up to 30 YEARS in prison.

Anthony is 64 years old.

If he's convicted...

...HE'LL LIKELY SPEND THE REST OF HIS LIFE LOCKED UP - AND DIE IN
PRISON - FOR DEFENDING HIMSELF.

THAT'S WHY I'M WRITING YOU - SOMEONE I'VE NEVER MET - TO ASK YOU TO
HELP MY BROTHER.
[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.

Anthony doesn't deserve this.

He served as a cop for four decades and never once faced discipline.
He has a spotless record full of awards and commendations.

Several years ago, Anthony and his wife took their two granddaughters
into their home. They've been raising them ever since.

You can imagine the pain it's caused these poor girls to have their
grandfather locked up and treated like a common criminal.

We were almost out of hope.

And then we found out about the LAW ENFORCEMENT LEGAL DEFENSE FUND.

LELDF is a national group that's helped dozens of innocent officers
clear their names when they're wrongly accused by radical prosecutors.

And they've agreed to help Anthony too.

Not only are they getting my brother the legal defense he deserves -
they're also raising money to pay for the best attorneys and expert
witnesses available.

Which brings me to the reason I wrote you today:

WILL YOU HELP MY BROTHER FIGHT THESE UNJUST CHARGES BY DONATING TO THE
LELDF?
[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.

The legal bills are already overwhelming. And we haven't even gotten
to trial.

Anthony and his wife have already drained almost their entire life's
savings fighting to free him.

So any amount you can give today will help.

And because LELDF is a non-profit organization, your gift is
completely tax-deductible.

WHATEVER YOU CAN AFFORD TO GIVE, I'M ASKING YOU TO PLEASE MAKE YOUR
GIFT TODAY.

After four decades serving his community, the cancer, and the injuries
from his attack, Anthony deserves to spend his retirement years in
peace with his family - NOT locked up behind bars for the rest of his
life.

But that's exactly what will happen unless patriots like you step up
on his behalf.

Thank you for taking the time to read my email today.

THANK YOU IN ADVANCE FOR MAKING YOUR TAX-DEDUCTIBLE GIFT TO HELP
ANTHONY FIGHT TO CLEAR HIS NAME.

And please, keep my brother in your prayers.

_FRANK DELUSTRO_

P.S. Anthony didn’t know it at the time, but the road-rage maniac
who attacked him had a criminal record. Maybe that’s why he was so
eager to flee the scene after my brother arrested him.

PLEASE HELP SAVE ANTHONY FROM SPENDING THE REST OF HIS LIFE BEHIND
BARS. MAKE A TAX-DEDUCTIBLE GIFT OF ANY AMOUNT TO THE LAW ENFORCEMENT
LEGAL DEFENSE FUND RIGHT AWAY.

STAND WITH OFFICER DELUSTRO
[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.

[Image showing scoreboard and text]
[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.

_More such officers who sacrifice so much for will face similar fates
unless we speak out and stand up for the brave men and women in blue.
The next time you see a police officer in your community, please thank
them for their service. To read more about our mission or the other
Law Enforcement officers we're defending, please visit www.leldf.org.
And remember - Blue Lives Matter!_

JOIN OUR SUSTAINING MEMBERS BY MAKING A MONTHLY GIFT TO LELDF TODAY!

| | | Fellow American, **Votes are still being counted in Alaska.** Right now, just hundreds of votes separate Senator Dan Sullivan and Mary Peltola. Out of every ballot cast across the whole state, it comes down to a few hundred. That’s not a lead. _That’s a coin flip._ Here’s what makes my blood boil: Democrats played a dirty trick in this race. They recruited a second “Dan Sullivan” to get on the ballot, a fake candidate with the same name with ties to the Democrats meant to confuse voters and pull votes away from the real one. _And it worked well enough to matter_. If the fake weren’t in this race, Dan would be leading right now. I knew what they were up to. That’s why I got on a plane and went to Alaska to campaign for Dan BEFORE Election Day.
